opportunities.title: Video Animado entrega 3 días
opportunities.description: BRIEF TÉCNICO DE PRODUCCIÓN AUDIOVISUAL Cliente: Priscila Bethancourt. Tipo de proyecto: Producción audiovisual explicativa, académica e institucional. 1. OBJETIVO DEL PROYECTO Producir un video resumen de una investigación universitaria sobre las alertas meteorológicas en a. El objetivo es transformar el contenido de la investigación en una pieza audiovisual dinámica, visualmente atractiva y fácil de comprender, que mantenga la atención de los espectadores y permita explicar los principales conceptos, datos y conclusiones del trabajo. No se busca una presentación convencional de diapositivas, sino una producción audiovisual con recursos gráficos, animaciones, infografías y material visual de apoyo. 2. MATERIALES PROPORCIONADOS POR LA CLIENTE La cliente compartió una carpeta de Google Drive con el material de producción: Según lo indicado por la cliente, contiene: 1. Guion: estructura y contenido narrativo del video. 2. Storyboard: referencia visual de las escenas y los elementos que podrían acompañar cada fragmento de la locución. 3. Locución: narración de voz en off que servirá como base para organizar y sincronizar el video. 4. Clips audiovisuales: videos que pueden utilizarse como material complementario en determinadas escenas. 5. Logotipos: recursos de identidad visual para incorporar donde corresponda. La cliente confirma que el storyboard es orientativo y que no es obligatorio reproducir exactamente sus indicaciones. Existe libertad creativa para proponer soluciones visuales que mejoren el resultado. Antes de comenzar: revisar todos los archivos de la carpeta, escuchar la locución completa y estudiar el guion y storyboard. 3. DIRECCIÓN CREATIVA Y ESTILO VISUAL La cliente quiere un video dinámico que mantenga la atención de los espectadores. Se recomienda una estética: - Profesional, moderna e institucional. - Académica, pero visualmente atractiva. - Limpia y organizada. - Con buena jerarquía visual. - Con transiciones fluidas y movimientos naturales. - Con variedad de recursos gráficos para evitar escenas estáticas prolongadas. Se pueden combinar infografías animadas, ilustraciones, mapas, estadísticas, textos, iconos, imágenes y clips reales. La animación debe cumplir una función explicativa, no utilizarse únicamente como decoración. 4. RECURSOS VISUALES QUE DEBE INCLUIR LA PRODUCCIÓN A. Infografías y estadísticas - Representación visual de datos relevantes de la investigación. - Gráficos animados y elementos estadísticos. - Diagramas y esquemas explicativos. - Cifras y conceptos destacados en pantalla. B. Mapas y elementos meteorológicos - Mapas de República Dominicana cuando corresponda. - Representaciones visuales de alertas meteorológicas. - Iconografía relacionada con el clima y los fenómenos meteorológicos. - Elementos gráficos que ayuden a explicar la información geográfica. C. Textos y títulos - Títulos animados. - Palabras clave destacadas. - Textos explicativos breves. - Subtítulos sincronizados con la narración. D. Animaciones y transiciones - Movimientos gráficos fluidos. - Transiciones profesionales. - Animación de elementos visuales. - Composiciones dinámicas que acompañen la explicación. E. Clips y recursos audiovisuales - Aprovechar los videos proporcionados por la cliente cuando sean relevantes. - Incorporar los logotipos suministrados. - Combinar material real con recursos gráficos para enriquecer la narrativa. 5. ESTRUCTURA NARRATIVA La producción debe seguir el guion y la locución proporcionados por la cliente. Como referencia, la narrativa contempla: 1. Introducción y presentación del tema. 2. Contexto de las alertas meteorológicas en República Dominicana. 3. Desarrollo de los aspectos principales de la investigación. 4. Presentación de datos y hallazgos relevantes. 5. Conclusiones y cierre. El orden definitivo debe respetar el guion entregado. No agregar información, estadísticas ni conclusiones que no estén respaldadas por el material de la investigación. 6. AUDIO Y LOCUCIÓN - Utilizar la locución proporcionada por la cliente. - Sincronizar las escenas y animaciones con la narración. - Incorporar música de fondo apropiada para una producción académica e institucional. - Realizar mezcla y nivelación de audio. - Mantener la voz clara y por encima de la música. - Incorporar efectos sonoros sutiles cuando aporten valor. La locución será la guía principal para establecer el ritmo y la duración de las escenas. 7. ESPECIFICACIONES TÉCNICAS - Duración estimada: 2 minutos y 30 segundos a 3 minutos y 30 segundos. - Orientación: horizontal 16:9. - Resolución: 1920 × 1080 píxeles. - Calidad: Full HD. - Formato de entrega: MP4. - Audio: locución, música y mezcla. - Textos: títulos y subtítulos integrados. La duración debe ajustarse al contenido real de la locución y al guion aprobado. 8. ENTREGABLE FINAL Se debe entregar: 1. Video completo en formato MP4 y resolución Full HD. 2. Todas las escenas editadas y ensambladas. 3. Recursos gráficos, infografías y animaciones integrados. 4. Locución sincronizada. 5. Música de fondo y mezcla de audio. 6. Subtítulos integrados. 7. Transiciones y acabado audiovisual profesional. 9. RONDAS DE CORRECCIONES El proyecto contempla dos rondas de ajustes gratuitos: Primera ronda: correcciones generales de textos, escenas, sincronización, gráficos y detalles visuales. Segunda ronda: aplicación de observaciones finales y refinamiento de los elementos previamente corregidos. Las correcciones deben mantenerse dentro del guion, storyboard y alcance acordados. Los cambios sustanciales de concepto, nuevas secciones o ampliaciones importantes del contenido quedan fuera de las revisiones ordinarias. 10. CRITERIOS DE CALIDAD El resultado debe cumplir con lo siguiente: - Mantener la atención del espectador. - Tener una narrativa visual coherente. - Evitar escenas excesivamente estáticas. - Presentar datos e infografías fáciles de comprender. - Utilizar animaciones que refuercen la explicación. - Mantener consistencia gráfica durante todo el video. - Respetar el contenido académico de la investigación. - Garantizar buena sincronización entre imagen y locución. - Tener un acabado profesional apropiado para una presentación universitaria. INSTRUCCIÓN GENERAL PARA EL EDITOR La prioridad es convertir el guion, storyboard y locución de la cliente en un video explicativo de calidad profesional. La cliente no ha establecido ningún software ni técnica de producción obligatoria. El editor tiene libertad para seleccionar las herramientas y los métodos de trabajo que considere más adecuados, siempre que se respete el resultado visual solicitado. Se recomienda dar protagonismo a las infografías, mapas, estadísticas y elementos animados, combinándolos con clips reales y otros recursos visuales cuando corresponda. Importante: no comenzar a producir escenas aisladas sin revisar primero la totalidad de la locución y el storyboard. Es necesario organizar la secuencia completa, identificar qué recurso visual acompañará cada fragmento de audio y mantener una continuidad narrativa de principio a fin.

MATERIALES PROPORCIONADOS POR LA CLIENTE La cliente compartió una carpeta de Google Drive con el material de producción: Según lo indicado por la cliente, contiene: 1. Guion: estructura y contenido narrativo del video. 2. Storyboard: referencia visual de las escenas y los elementos que podrían acompañar cada fragmento de la locución. 3. Locución: narración de voz en off que servirá como base para organizar y sincronizar el video. 4. Clips audiovisuales: videos que pueden utilizarse como material complementario en determinadas escenas. 5. Logotipos: recursos de identidad visual para incorporar donde corresponda. La cliente confirma que el storyboard es orientativo y que no es obligatorio reproducir exactamente sus indicaciones. Existe libertad creativa para proponer soluciones visuales que mejoren el resultado. Antes de comenzar: revisar todos los archivos de la carpeta, escuchar la locución completa y estudiar el guion y storyboard. 3. DIRECCIÓN CREATIVA Y ESTILO VISUAL La cliente quiere un video dinámico que mantenga la atención de los espectadores. Se recomienda una estética: - Profesional, moderna e institucional. - Académica, pero visualmente atractiva. - Limpia y organizada. - Con buena jerarquía visual. - Con transiciones fluidas y movimientos naturales. - Con variedad de recursos gráficos para evitar escenas estáticas prolongadas. Se pueden combinar infografías animadas, ilustraciones, mapas, estadísticas, textos, iconos, imágenes y clips reales. La animación debe cumplir una función explicativa, no utilizarse únicamente como decoración. 4. RECURSOS VISUALES QUE DEBE INCLUIR LA PRODUCCIÓN A. Infografías y estadísticas - Representación visual de datos relevantes de la investigación. - Gráficos animados y elementos estadísticos. - Diagramas y esquemas explicativos. - Cifras y conceptos destacados en pantalla. B. Mapas y elementos meteorológicos - Mapas de República Dominicana cuando corresponda. - Representaciones visuales de alertas meteorológicas. - Iconografía relacionada con el clima y los fenómenos meteorológicos. - Elementos gráficos que ayuden a explicar la información geográfica. C. Textos y títulos - Títulos animados. - Palabras clave destacadas. - Textos explicativos breves. - Subtítulos sincronizados con la narración. D. Animaciones y transiciones - Movimientos gráficos fluidos. - Transiciones profesionales. - Animación de elementos visuales. - Composiciones dinámicas que acompañen la explicación. E. Clips y recursos audiovisuales - Aprovechar los videos proporcionados por la cliente cuando sean relevantes. - Incorporar los logotipos suministrados. - Combinar material real con recursos gráficos para enriquecer la narrativa. 5. ESTRUCTURA NARRATIVA La producción debe seguir el guion y la locución proporcionados por la cliente. Como referencia, la narrativa contempla: 1. Introducción y presentación del tema. 2. Contexto de las alertas meteorológicas en República Dominicana. 3. Desarrollo de los aspectos principales de la investigación. 4. Presentación de datos y hallazgos relevantes. 5. Conclusiones y cierre. El orden definitivo debe respetar el guion entregado. No agregar información, estadísticas ni conclusiones que no estén respaldadas por el material de la investigación. 6. AUDIO Y LOCUCIÓN - Utilizar la locución proporcionada por la cliente. - Sincronizar las escenas y animaciones con la narración. - Incorporar música de fondo apropiada para una producción académica e institucional. - Realizar mezcla y nivelación de audio. - Mantener la voz clara y por encima de la música. - Incorporar efectos sonoros sutiles cuando aporten valor. La locución será la guía principal para establecer el ritmo y la duración de las escenas. 7. ESPECIFICACIONES TÉCNICAS - Duración estimada: 2 minutos y 30 segundos a 3 minutos y 30 segundos. - Orientación: horizontal 16:9. - Resolución: 1920 × 1080 píxeles. - Calidad: Full HD. - Formato de entrega: MP4. - Audio: locución, música y mezcla. - Textos: títulos y subtítulos integrados. La duración debe ajustarse al contenido real de la locución y al guion aprobado. 8. ENTREGABLE FINAL Se debe entregar: 1. Video completo en formato MP4 y resolución Full HD. 2. Todas las escenas editadas y ensambladas. 3. Recursos gráficos, infografías y animaciones integrados. 4. Locución sincronizada. 5. Música de fondo y mezcla de audio. 6. Subtítulos integrados. 7. Transiciones y acabado audiovisual profesional. 9. RONDAS DE CORRECCIONES El proyecto contempla dos rondas de ajustes gratuitos: Primera ronda: correcciones generales de textos, escenas, sincronización, gráficos y detalles visuales. Segunda ronda: aplicación de observaciones finales y refinamiento de los elementos previamente corregidos. Las correcciones deben mantenerse dentro del guion, storyboard y alcance acordados. Los cambios sustanciales de concepto, nuevas secciones o ampliaciones importantes del contenido quedan fuera de las revisiones ordinarias. 10. CRITERIOS DE CALIDAD El resultado debe cumplir con lo siguiente: - Mantener la atención del espectador. - Tener una narrativa visual coherente. - Evitar escenas excesivamente estáticas. - Presentar datos e infografías fáciles de comprender. - Utilizar animaciones que refuercen la explicación. - Mantener consistencia gráfica durante todo el video. - Respetar el contenido académico de la investigación. - Garantizar buena sincronización entre imagen y locución. - Tener un acabado profesional apropiado para una presentación universitaria. INSTRUCCIÓN GENERAL PARA EL EDITOR La prioridad es convertir el guion, storyboard y locución de la cliente en un video explicativo de calidad profesional. La cliente no ha establecido ningún software ni técnica de producción obligatoria. El editor tiene libertad para seleccionar las herramientas y los métodos de trabajo que considere más adecuados, siempre que se respete el resultado visual solicitado. Se recomienda dar protagonismo a las infografías, mapas, estadísticas y elementos animados, combinándolos con clips reales y otros recursos visuales cuando corresponda. Importante: no comenzar a producir escenas aisladas sin revisar primero la totalidad de la locución y el storyboard. Es necesario organizar la secuencia completa, identificar qué recurso visual acompañará cada fragmento de audio y mantener una continuidad narrativa de principio a fin."

opportunities.title: Entrevista a Ingenieros Tech Remotos LATINOS
opportunities.description: Título: Entrevista de 1 hora a LATINOS que son Software/Data Engineers latinoamericanos que trabajan remoto en empresas internacionales (USD 20) Descripción: Hola, soy profesor de inglés para ingenieros de software y de datos, y estoy construyendo un programa de inglés especializado para perfiles tech. Para que sea realmente útil, quiero aprender de personas que ya viven este proceso día a día. Busco IA Engineers, Software Engineers, Data Engineers y perfiles afines para una entrevista por videollamada de 1 hora donde conversaremos sobre: - Cómo es el ambiente laboral en una empresa internacional. -Tu experiencia trabajando de forma remota con equipos de otros países Los retos que enfrentas con el inglés en el trabajo (reuniones, daily stand-ups, entrevistas, escritura, Slack, etc.) -Cómo aprendiste inglés y qué te funcionó (y qué no) -Pago: USD 20 por la sesión de 1 hora. Requisitos: -Trabajar actualmente de forma remota para una empresa internacional -Ser ingeniero de software, ingeniero de datos o un rol técnico similar. -Tener un nivel de inglés intermedio o superior Ser latinoamericano, con español como lengua nativa -Tener buena conexión a internet y disponibilidad para una videollamada a través de Freelancer. opportunities.title: Cold Caller B2B con Español por Comisión -- 2
opportunities.description: Busco alguien ambicioso, que tenga experiencia realizando Cold Calls y quiera hacer dinero. Solo se aceptan candidatos con Español nativo, o con excelente manejo del mismo. Nuestra empresa ofrece servicios de marketing digital, software dedicado y diseño web a otras empresas, por lo que seria ideal que tu cuentes con experiencia B2B. No queremos a un empleado, queremos a alguien se se sume al proyecto y trabaje igual de duro que todos nosotros para que, en equipo, podamos hacer dinero. No recibirás un sueldo ( mientras estes en tu periodo de prueba ) pero si recibirás un 10% de cada venta cerrada por nuestro equipo de closers que TU hayas logrado pasar a WhatsApp, lo que supondría como mínimo, de 100 a 500 dólares por venta para ti, ya que nuestro ticket mas bajo comienza en los $999 y no tiene techo, llegando a poder hacer paquetes de 30k. Esa será tu única tarea, llamar a pequeñas, medianas y grandes empresas hispanas en todo el mundo con la finalidad de llevarlos a WhatsApp, para que nosotros podamos hacerle el appointment Setting. Una vez pases el periodo de prueba, seguidas cobrando en base a comisiones, pero se te añadirá un fijo mensual basado en cuantas llamadas seas capaz de hacer al dia.

opportunities.title: Reconstrucción y Optimización de Tienda Nube para Alta Conversión

Las tareas incluyen la configuración y optimización SEO para mejorar la visibilidad en motores de búsqueda, el rediseño de las páginas de productos para hacerlas más atractivas y funcionales, la creación de banners impactantes y la implementación de todas las mejoras necesarias para que la página convierta eficazmente a los visitantes en clientes. Se requiere un enfoque integral que abarque tanto la funcionalidad técnica como la estética orientada a ventas. opportunities.title: Logo minimalista para marca textil
opportunities.description: Busco un diseño de logo limpio, elegante y minimalista que represente mi nueva marca de remeras y pantalones cortos — el short de color azul es un elemento clave de la identidad, así que debe quedar claro, ya sea a través de la paleta cromática, un ícono sutil o un detalle gráfico distintivo. opportunities.title: Televentas Upsell en Español
opportunities.description: Tengo una base de clientes que ya utilizan algunos de nuestros servicios y quiero maximizar el valor de cada cuenta. Necesito apoyo de un vendedor nativo o bilingüe en español que se encargue exclusivamente de ventas por teléfono. La tarea consiste en llamar a estos clientes actuales, detectar necesidades adicionales y cerrar la venta durante la misma conversación. No es un rol de prospección ni de agendar citas: el éxito se mide porque el cliente acepte la oferta y realice la compra en la llamada. Para trabajar cómodamente compartiré: • Listado depurado de clientes con historial y notas. • Guión flexible, precios y argumentario de beneficios. • Acceso al CRM para registrar cada intento y resultado. Qué espero recibir al final de cada jornada: • Registro actualizado en el CRM con estado de cada llamada. • Grabaciones o resumen escrito de objeciones y cómo se resolvieron. • Número de ventas cerradas y monto total. El producto ya es conocido por el cliente, así que la conversación será directa y orientada a valor adicional. Si ya tienes experiencia en upselling telefónico, dominan técnicas de cierre inmediato y te sientes cómodo trabajando con métricas diarias, avísame y arrancamos lo antes posible.

opportunities.title: WordPress QA Testing and Bug Fixes
opportunities.description: I need a QA / test automation specialist to fully test my WordPress website on desktop and mobile, fix small bugs, and report the results. The website link will be shared with the selected freelancer after hiring. The site includes choir search and filters, free taster booking, membership sign-up, forms, and general navigation. Scope of testing: - Pages and navigation: every page, menu, button and link. Check for broken links, 404 errors and missing images. - Choir search and filters: search by keyword and location, combine filters, check that empty results show a sensible message and that results are correct. - Free taster booking flow: complete the booking from start to finish, check form validation and the confirmation message. - Membership flow: sign-up, login, logout, password reset, and access to members-only pages. - Forms: required fields, error messages, successful submission, and spam protection. - Responsiveness: desktop (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge) and mobile/tablet (iOS Safari, Android Chrome). - Basic checks: JavaScript console errors, slow-loading pages, and obvious layout breaks. Bug fixing: - Fix small issues such as CSS and layout problems, broken links, form settings, and plugin configuration. - Report anything that would take more than about 30 minutes before working on it. It will need my approval. - Make fixes on a staging copy first, then move them to the live site. Access provided after hiring: - WordPress admin access and a staging site - Test details for booking and membership. Please don't send real payments or use real customer data. Deliverables: 1. A test report (spreadsheet or document) showing each test, pass or fail, and screenshots of failures 2. A list of the bugs fixed, with before and after notes 3. A list of remaining issues and recommendations 4. Your automation scripts (Playwright preferred) so I can rerun the tests later Requirements: - Proven experience with WordPress testing and debugging - Hands-on experience with Playwright, Selenium, Cypress or similar tools - Ability to start immediately Timeline: 6 hours. Testing and the report come first, then the fixes. To apply, please include: - A short summary of similar WordPress QA work you've done - Which tool you'll use and why - The first 2-3 things you would test on this site

Bug fixing: - Fix small issues such as CSS and layout problems, broken links, form settings, and plugin configuration. - Report anything that would take more than about 30 minutes before working on it. Access provided after hiring: - WordPress admin access and a staging site - Test details for booking and membership. Please don't send real payments or use real customer data. Deliverables: 1. A test report (spreadsheet or document) showing each test, pass or fail, and screenshots of failures 2. A list of the bugs fixed, with before and after notes 3. A list of remaining issues and recommendations 4. Your automation scripts (Playwright preferred) so I can rerun the tests later Requirements: - Proven experience with WordPress testing and debugging - Hands-on experience with Playwright, Selenium, Cypress or similar tools - Ability to start immediately Timeline: 6 hours. opportunities.title: API Security Best Practices Guide
opportunities.description: I am building a proof-of-concept automation script for a future video-calling product and need a seasoned API security professional to review the overall design before I write a single line of code. Because I do not have permission to probe the live app that inspired this idea, we will keep the work strictly theoretical and best-practice-oriented. My immediate goals are to • understand how to inspect and log GET and POST traffic safely during development • design a referral flow that unlocks extra features or free usage for successful invites without opening abuse vectors • integrate Google OAuth sign-in while avoiding the common pitfalls around token handling, refresh logic, and scope creep Please focus on secure architecture patterns, recommended tools (e.g., Postman, OWASP ZAP, Burp Suite, Wireshark), and practical checklists I can follow later when I do have permission to run tests. Deliverables • A concise written guide (Markdown or PDF) covering the three areas above, including illustrative sequence diagrams or sample cURL/Postman calls where useful • A risk matrix highlighting common attack surfaces for referral systems and OAuth flows, with mitigation steps • A short call or recorded walkthrough (30–45 min) to clarify questions that arise after I read the material Acceptance criteria: the guide must be actionable for a beginner-to-intermediate developer, cite authoritative sources (OWASP, Google Identity docs), and map each recommendation back to the specific goals stated.

opportunities.title: Comprehensive API Test Automation
opportunities.description: I have a spreadsheet-driven workflow that talks to a custom business app through an HTTP API. To safeguard that link I want a fully automated test suite. The goal is simple: every change to either side should immediately be validated so I know the API still • returns the exact data the spreadsheet expects • responds with clear, correct error messages when something goes wrong • stays fast and reliable even when hammered with a high volume of requests You may build the suite in the toolset you are most comfortable with—Postman + Newman, REST-assured, pytest, JMeter, or a comparable framework—as long as the tests can run headless in our CI pipeline and output a concise report (JSON or HTML). The current API is REST/JSON with token-based auth; I will provide the spec and sample credentials. Deliverables 1. Well-structured test scripts covering success, error, and load scenarios 2. A command-line runner or pipeline step that can be scheduled or triggered on commit 3. Clear documentation on setup, configuration, and how to add new tests I can spin up a staging environment for you on day one, and I’m ready to review milestones as soon as basic smoke tests are in place. Let me know your estimated turnaround and which framework you’d prefer so we can get started.

opportunities.title: Diseño Integral de Interiores y Exteriores para Tienda de Salud y B...
opportunities.description: Se busca un profesional para el diseño integral de interiores y exteriores de una nueva tienda de salud nutricional y bienestar, llamada Bali. El espacio a diseñar tiene una superficie de entre 25 y 35 m2. Es fundamental que el diseño incorpore y refleje los colores de marca existentes y el logotipo de la tienda, que será proporcionado. Para el diseño interior, se requiere una distribución funcional y atractiva que contemple las siguientes áreas clave: - Zonas de exhibición y asesoría para productos. - Sección dedicada a salud femenina. - ÁRea para productos y estrategias de control de obesidad. - Espacio para suplementación deportiva. - Zona específica para suplementación orientada al control de la depresión y la ansiedad. La tienda se enfocará en ofrecer marcas originales y productos respaldados por investigación científica comprobada, así como la mejor asesoría a los clientes. El diseño debe transmitir esta filosofía de calidad, confianza y bienestar, creando un ambiente acogedor y profesional. Se espera una propuesta que optimice el espacio disponible y cree una experiencia de compra única para los clientes. Categoría: Ingeniería y Arquitectura Subcategoría: Diseño de interiores Tamaño del proyecto: Pequeño

opportunities.title: Captador/a de propietarios en Madrid – gestión de alquileres (remot...
opportunities.description: H50 HOMES, una empresa española en expansión especializada en la gestión de alquileres, busca un/a captador/a de propietarios para unirse a su equipo de forma remota. El objetivo principal es identificar y contactar a propietarios particulares en Madrid para incorporar sus propiedades a la cartera de la empresa. Se busca una persona responsable, organizada y orientada a resultados, con el fin de establecer una relación de colaboración estable y a largo plazo. Funciones principales: - Búsqueda activa de propietarios particulares a través de portales inmobiliarios como Idealista, Fotocasa y otros. - Creación y mantenimiento de una base de datos de propietarios potenciales, incluyendo el filtrado de anuncios relevantes. - Realización del primer contacto con los propietarios mediante llamadas telefónicas, WhatsApp o mensajería de los portales, utilizando el argumentario proporcionado por la empresa. - Seguimiento de los propietarios interesados hasta que sean transferidos a la Dirección para el cierre del acuerdo. - Registro detallado de todos los contactos y oportunidades generadas, así como la elaboración de informes regulares sobre los resultados obtenidos. Condiciones del proyecto: - Modalidad 100% remota. - Dedicación de 6 horas diarias, de lunes a viernes, preferiblemente en horario partido (3 horas por la mañana y 3 horas por la tarde). - Las franjas horarias más efectivas para realizar llamadas son a partir de las 10:30 am y las 5:00 pm (hora de españa). - Se requiere compatibilidad horaria con España. Es posible compaginar con otros proyectos siempre que se cubra el horario íntegramente. Retribución: - Un fijo mensual de 300 EUR. - Un variable de 75 EUR por cada piso captado e incorporado a la cartera (una vez que el propietario firma el contrato de gestión). - Posibilidad de un BONUS adicional por volumen mensual. - El pago se realizará mensualmente mediante factura o documento de cobro como profesional independiente. - Existe la posibilidad de ampliar las horas y la retribución en función de los resultados obtenidos. Requisitos del perfil: - Español nativo o con un nivel muy alto, con excelente dicción y claridad al hablar. - Experiencia previa demostrable en ventas, teleoperación, captación de clientes o atención al cliente. - Comodidad y soltura en la realización de llamadas comerciales. - Manejo fluido de herramientas como Google Sheets/Excel, WhatsApp y correo electrónico. - Disponibilidad estable y capacidad para emitir factura en su país de residencia. - Se valorará positivamente la experiencia en llamadas en frío, conocimiento del sector inmobiliario, uso de Idealista, experiencia con clientes españoles y manejo de Crm. al postularte, cuéntanos tu experiencia, un ejemplo concreto de captación o llamadas en frío con su resultado, tu país y ciudad, tu disponibilidad y por qué buscas un proyecto a largo plazo. Categoría: Marketing Digital y Ventas Subcategoría: Televentas Tiempo requerido: Más de 20 horas

opportunities.title: Creación de Branding Integral para Gastro Bar 'Wolf City'
opportunities.description: Se busca un profesional para desarrollar la identidad de marca completa para un nuevo gastro bar llamado 'Wolf City'. opportunities.title: Luxury Chauffeur CRM & Email Automation
opportunities.description: I need help turning years of Gmail bookings and enquiries for my luxury chauffeur service into a single, well-structured customer database, then using that data to run ongoing email marketing. First, all contacts—from confirmed riders to one-off enquiry senders—have to be exported, cleaned and deduplicated so the final list holds each person’s name, email address and phone number only. Once the list is ready, I’d like a CRM configured around it (I’m open to whichever platform you recommend) and a simple tagging or segmentation scheme so I can easily spot past customers versus prospects. The first automated flow I want live is a regular “luxury travel updates & special offers” series that keeps the brand top-of-mind and drives repeat bookings. I’m looking for guidance on best-practice copy length, template design that fits a premium brand, and basic performance tracking so I can see opens, clicks and subsequent bookings at a glance. Key deliverables • Clean, centralised customer database (name, email, phone) • CRM set-up with segments/tags and integration to my business Gmail • Automated email sequence for ongoing travel updates and special offers, fully tested and ready to send Success for me is a system I can maintain myself after hand-over, plus clear written instructions so future campaigns are easy to build on.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40817203, publicado hace 1 hora (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: AUD 30 - 250.

opportunities.title: Bot Login 401 Error Fix
opportunities.description: J’ai développé un bot qui se connecte normalement avec un identifiant et un mot de passe, envoyés directement par requête HTTP vers l’URL de connexion du site. Or, chaque tentative renvoie systématiquement une réponse 401 Unauthorized. Je cherche à comprendre puis corriger ce blocage : en particulier la gestion des en-têtes, cookies, éventuels jetons CSRF ou redirections que le site attend mais que ma requête ignore. Le code est court, bien structuré, et je peux fournir immédiatement : script actuel, URL concernée, traces de requête/réponse (curl ou Postman), ainsi que les identifiants de test. Livrable attendu • Analyse de la séquence de connexion (headers, cookies, … ) • Correctif ou snippet prêt à intégrer pour obtenir une réponse 200/302 valide • Brève explication pour que je puisse ajuster moi-même de futurs appels Le tout : propre, commenté, reproductible. Merci !

opportunities.title: : 3D Previs / Layout Artist or Animator (3ds Max / Blender) – 10x 15-Sec Dynamic Action Shots
opportunities.description: Looking for a talented 3D Animator or Previs/Layout Artist to animate a batch of ten 15-second sci-fi action-comedy shots (360 frames at 24 fps each) using primitive proxies. What is already built: • All environment geometry and primitive character proxies (capsules/blocks with directional face markers) are already built in 3ds Max (can be delivered as .max, .fbx, or .obj if you prefer working in Blender). • No modeling, texturing, lighting, or skeletal character rigging is required. What you need to do: 1. Primitive Blocking & Action Pacing: Animate the movement, physical interactions, and fast-paced action/dialogue timing of the primitive characters based on the script. 2. Dynamic Camera Work (Main Focus): Set up cinematic, blockbuster-style camera animation with cuts. Zero static cameras. o I need organic handheld motion, subtle floating, breathing, whip-pans, and dynamic tracking suited for intense action. o Important technical requirement: Subtle camera movements and micro-motions must be keyframe-animated manually via both the Camera and its Target (Aim)—DO NOT just slap a procedural Noise modifier/controller on the camera. Deliverables (per shot): • Native project file (.max or .blend) with clean scene organization and camera cuts set up on the timeline. • Clean viewport playblast / preview render (.mp4, 1080p, 24 fps) in shaded/solid mode (NO wireframe/edged faces), with timecode overlay. How to Apply & Free Sample Test: • Please bid your total package price for all 10 shots (10 x 15 sec = 2.5 minutes total). • Before awarding the full 10-shot contract, shortlisted candidates will be asked to do a quick, free 3–5 second camera & blocking sample on the provided base scene to verify your sense of action timing and manual Camera + Target animation

opportunities.description: PAMACOL, distribuidor en Colombia de marcas reconocidas como Garmin, Insta360, Shokz, Tacx y Chemelo, busca un freelancer altamente calificado y experto en vtex io para asumir el desarrollo, diseño ux/ui y soporte continuo de nuestras plataformas de comercio electrónico. Actualmente, todas nuestras marcas se venden en un único sitio garmin.com.co (vtex io, aproximadamente 418 sku). Contamos también con tiendas en México (Shopify) y Panamá (WooCommerce), y nuestro ERP es Oracle NetSuite con API. opportunities.title: Especialista en Campañas de Google y Meta para Maximizar Ventas Online
opportunities.description: Se busca un especialista experimentado en la gestión de campañas de publicidad digital en Google y Meta, con un enfoque principal en el crecimiento de ventas online y la optimización del rendimiento. El profesional será responsable de la planificación estratégica, implementación, monitoreo y optimización continua de campañas de performance, asegurando el cumplimiento de los objetivos de conversión y el crecimiento sostenido del canal digital. Las responsabilidades clave incluyen: - Desarrollar y ejecutar estrategias de campañas en Google Ads (Search, Display, Shopping) y Meta Ads (Facebook, Instagram). - Realizar análisis de datos y reportería detallada utilizando Google Analytics 4 (GA4). - Identificar oportunidades de mejora y proponer recomendaciones basadas en datos para optimizar el ROI y la eficiencia de las campañas. - Asegurar la correcta atribución y seguimiento de conversiones. Se requiere experiencia comprobada en la gestión de presupuestos de marketing digital, capacidad para interpretar métricas complejas y una mentalidad orientada a resultados para impulsar el éxito de las ventas online. Categoría: Marketing Digital y Ventas Subcategoría: Publicidad en Google, Facebook ¿Qué necesitas?: Campañas de presupuesto alto o gran cantidad de productos y mercados

opportunities.title: Salesforce CRM & AdSense Automation Platform
opportunities.description: We are seeking an experienced full-stack developer to develop a comprehensive CRM and marketing automation platform integrating Salesforce, Ruby on Rails, and Google AdSense. The platform will centralize customer relationship management, automate sales operations, monitor advertising performance, and provide actionable business analytics. Project Requirements 1. Salesforce App Development - Develop custom Salesforce applications. - Implement Apex classes, triggers, and Lightning Web Components. - Integrate Salesforce with external applications through APIs. - Automate lead management and sales processes. 2. Salesforce.com - Customize Salesforce objects, dashboards, and reports. - Configure workflows, validation rules, and permissions. - Implement automated customer data synchronization. - Optimize Salesforce performance and scalability. 3. Google AdSense - Integrate Google AdSense reporting capabilities. - Monitor advertising impressions, clicks, and revenue. - Develop advertising performance dashboards. - Analyze advertising metrics and revenue trends. 4. Ruby on Rails - Develop a scalable backend using Ruby on Rails. - Build RESTful APIs and database architecture. - Implement authentication and authorization. - Integrate third-party services and external APIs. - Ensure application security and performance. 5. CRM Development - Build comprehensive customer and contact management. - Implement lead tracking and sales pipeline management. - Develop customer segmentation and activity tracking. - Automate follow-ups and customer notifications. - Create advanced reporting and analytics dashboards. Expected Deliverables - Fully functional CRM platform. - Salesforce application and API integrations. - Google AdSense reporting integration. - Ruby on Rails backend infrastructure. - Responsive administrative dashboard. - Automated business workflows. - Technical documentation and deployment.

opportunities.title: Animate Magical 3D Kids Cartoon
opportunities.description: # MIKO AND THE MAGICAL RAINBOW FOREST ## Episode 1 – The Missing Rainbow Crystal **Production:** 3D animated children's cartoon **Language:** English **Target duration:** Approximately 6 minutes **Voice cast:** One male narrator, three male characters and one female character --- ### SCENE 1 – THE MAGICAL FOREST **Time:** 00:00–00:40 **VISUAL:** A cinematic aerial shot of a colorful forest. Butterflies fly between flowers. Birds sing. A rainbow shines above the mountains. **AUDIO – SFX:** Birds chirping, gentle wind, flowing water. **BACKGROUND MUSIC:** Cheerful magical orchestral music. **NARRATOR (Male, warm and friendly):** "Once upon a time, beyond the green mountains and sparkling rivers, there was a beautiful magical forest called Rainbow Forest." "Every morning, a magical rainbow appeared in the sky, filling the forest with beautiful colors." "In this forest lived a little white rabbit named Miko and his best friend, Tutu, a tiny blue bird." **MIKO (Male, cheerful):** "Good morning, beautiful forest! What a wonderful day!" **TUTU (Male, funny):** "Good morning, Miko! Let's play! Let's fly! Let's have some fun!" **MIKO:** "Haha! Tutu, you are always so excited!" **TUTU:** "Of course! Being happy is my favorite hobby!" **SFX:** Funny cartoon giggle. --- ### SCENE 2 – THE RAINBOW DISAPPEARS **Time:** 00:40–01:20 **VISUAL:** The rainbow slowly disappears. The flowers lose their brightness. **SFX:** Magical fading sound, gentle suspense music. **NARRATOR:** "But one morning, something very strange happened. The beautiful rainbow suddenly disappeared!" **MIKO (Surprised):** "Oh no! Tutu! Look at the sky! Where has our rainbow gone?" **TUTU (Worried):** "What? No rainbow? Oh no! Our beautiful forest is going to become boring!" **MIKO:** "Don't worry, Tutu. We will find out what happened." **TUTU:** "Okay! But I hope we don't have to fight any scary monsters!" **MIKO (Laughing):** "Haha! Don't be silly!" --- ### SCENE 3 – LUNA THE FAIRY **Time:** 01:20–02:00 **VISUAL:** Pink sparkles appear. Luna flies down from the sky. **SFX:** Magical chimes, sparkling wand. **LUNA (Female, gentle):** "Hello, little friends! Please don't be afraid." **MIKO:** "Wow! Who are you?" **LUNA:** "I am Luna, the guardian fairy of Rainbow Forest." **TUTU (Excited):** "A real fairy! Can you give me magical superpowers?" **LUNA (Laughing):** "Perhaps someday, little bird!" **MIKO:** "But Luna, what happened to our rainbow?" **LUNA:** "The magical Rainbow Crystal has disappeared. Without it, our forest will lose all its beautiful colors." **MIKO (Determined):** "Don't worry, Luna! We will find the crystal and save our forest!" **LUNA:** "Thank you, Miko. Follow this magical map. It will guide you on your adventure." --- ### SCENE 4 – BOBO NEEDS HELP **Time:** 02:00–02:45 **VISUAL:** Miko and Tutu walk through the forest. They discover Bobo near a river. **SFX:** Flowing river, footsteps, funny bear sounds. **BOBO (Male, gentle):** "Help! Can somebody help me?" **MIKO:** "Hello! What happened?" **BOBO:** "I want to cross this river, but I am afraid." **TUTU:** "Don't worry! We can build a little bridge!" **MIKO:** "That's a great idea, Tutu!" **NARRATOR:** "Together, the friends collected wooden branches and built a small bridge. Soon, Bobo safely crossed the river." **BOBO (Happy):** "Thank you, friends! Can I join your adventure?" **MIKO:** "Of course! The more friends, the stronger the team!" **BOBO:** "Wonderful! And I have some honey biscuits to share!" **TUTU:** "Did someone say biscuits?" **SFX:** Funny laughter. --- ### SCENE 5 – THE MYSTERIOUS CAVE **Time:** 02:45–03:30 **VISUAL:** The friends approach a cave filled with glowing crystals. **BACKGROUND MUSIC:** Gentle mystery music. **NARRATOR:** "After a long journey, the friends reached a mysterious cave. Strange sounds echoed inside." **TUTU (Scared):** "Oh no! A dark cave! I don't want to go inside!" **BOBO:** "Don't worry, Tutu. We are all together." **MIKO:** "Come on, friends! Let's be brave!" **SFX:** Whooooooo! **TUTU:** "Ahhh! I heard something! I think it's a monster!" **BOBO:** "Wait! Listen carefully. Someone is crying!" **MIKO:** "You're right. Let's find out who it is." --- ### SCENE 6 – DODO AND THE CRYSTAL **Time:** 03:30–04:20 **VISUAL:** A tiny green dragon sits beside a glowing rainbow crystal. **SFX:** Soft dragon sniffles, crystal humming. **MIKO (Kindly):** "Hello, little friend. Why are you crying?" **DODO (Male, shy):** "I'm sorry! I found this shiny crystal and thought it was a beautiful toy." **TUTU:** "Wait a minute! That's our missing Rainbow Crystal!" **DODO:** "I didn't know it was important. Please don't be angry!" **MIKO:** "It's okay, Dodo. Everyone makes mistakes. What matters is learning from them." **DODO:** "Really? You aren't angry with me?" **MIKO:** "Of course not! Will you help us return the crystal?" **DODO:** "Yes! Here you go!" **BOBO:** "Would you like to join our team?" **DODO (Excited):** "Really? I would love to!" **TUTU:** "Welcome to the team, little dragon!" --- ### SCENE 7 – THE RAINBOW RETURNS **Time:** 04:20–05:20 **VISUAL:** The friends return to Luna. She places the crystal on a magical platform. **BACKGROUND MUSIC:** Emotional magical orchestral build-up. **LUNA:** "You found it! You really found the Rainbow Crystal!" **MIKO:** "Yes! And we also found a new friend!" **DODO:** "Hello, everyone! My name is Dodo!" **LUNA:** "Welcome, little Dodo!" **SFX:** Magical crystal activation, rising sparkling sound. **NARRATOR:** "As Luna placed the crystal on its magical platform, a beautiful golden light spread across the forest." "The flowers began to bloom. The butterflies started dancing. And suddenly, a magnificent rainbow appeared across the sky!" **TUTU (Excited):** "Wow! Look at that beautiful rainbow!" **BOBO:** "We did it! Our forest is beautiful again!" **DODO:** "This is the most wonderful thing I have ever seen!" **LUNA:** "You all saved our forest because you worked together and helped one another." --- ### SCENE 8 – THE FRIENDSHIP CELEBRATION **Time:** 05:20–06:00 **VISUAL:** All five characters dance together beneath the rainbow. **BACKGROUND MUSIC:** Happy children's celebration music. **BOBO:** "Everyone! It's celebration time! Who wants honey cake?" **TUTU:** "Meeee! I want two!" **MIKO (Laughing):** "Haha! Tutu, you always think about food!" **DODO:** "I am so happy I found such wonderful friends!" **LUNA:** "Always remember, little friends: kindness and friendship make the world magical." **NARRATOR:** "And so, Miko, Tutu, Bobo, Dodo and Luna lived happily in their beautiful Rainbow Forest." "Dear children, remember: Be kind, help others, share your happiness, and never give up!" **ALL CHARACTERS TOGETHER:** "Friendship makes magic! See you next time! Bye-bye!" **SFX:** Magical sparkle and cheerful ending sound. **END TITLE:** MIKO AND THE MAGICAL RAINBOW FOREST – THE END.

opportunities.title: AI Agent Systems Architect | Silicon Valley | Remote
opportunities.description: We are a Silicon Valley–based premium lifestyle business looking for a talented, hands-on AI Agent Systems Architect to work directly with our CEO. We want to build a scalable AI automation system connecting specialized agents across marketing, content production, SEO, customer engagement, and business operations. We are looking for someone who can design, integrate, deploy, and teach us how to operate the system — not someone who manually performs marketing or content tasks. We welcome creative, ambitious developers, including early-career talent with real working projects. First Paid Pilot — $300–$800 Build one fully automated workflow: Competitor Research → AI Marketing Ideas & Copywriting → Human Approval → Scheduled Instagram Publishing The workflow must: - Use AI agents to research competitors and generate marketing content automatically. - Transfer outputs between agents without manual copy-paste. - Allow our team to approve, reject, or request revisions. - Automatically publish approved content through the Instagram API at the scheduled time. - Support Facebook Page publishing if feasible. - Include task logs, error handling, retries, and failure alerts. - Run in a cloud environment without requiring the developer to stay online. The project will use test content and test accounts initially, followed by integration with our company-controlled Meta accounts after authorization. The budget covers this pilot only, not our entire future automation system. Payment: Two milestones — 40% for a working agent and approval workflow; 60% for completed publishing integration, testing, documentation, and training. Technical Skills - OpenAI Codex and/or Claude Code - n8n or similar workflow automation platform - GitHub, Python or JavaScript - APIs, webhooks, databases, and cloud deployment - AI agent orchestration, logging, and troubleshooting Bonus: Muse, Grok, LangGraph, Meta Graph API, WhatsApp Business API. We value practical ability, independent thinking, and cost-effective solutions more than degrees or years of experience. Individual developers preferred. No agencies. Mandatory Training & Ownership - Deliver working source code and workflows in company-controlled systems. - Provide documentation, an operating manual, and recorded hands-on training. - Train our designated team member to operate the workflow independently. - Accept a written IP assignment agreement for custom-developed deliverables. - Disclose any third-party software, licensing requirements, or recurring costs. Communication - Worldwide remote applicants welcome. - At least 2 hours of weekday overlap with California Pacific Time business hours. - Clear English communication and regular progress updates. - Chinese is not required. How to Apply Please include: 1. Links to 1–3 real AI automation projects you personally developed. 2. Your proposed tools and approach for this pilot. 3. Your fixed-price quote ($300–$800) and timeline. 4. Your country, time zone, and Pacific Time availability. 5. Confirmation that you will personally develop the system and provide training, documentation, and IP handover. Successful collaboration may lead to additional projects and a long-term AI technical advisory role. Detailed company and product information will be shared only with shortlisted candidates.

opportunities.title: On-Demand Data Transfer Automation
opportunities.description: I need a small, reliable tool that lets me move data between two specific online apps whenever I choose to trigger it. The workflow is simple: I press a button (or run a script/command), the tool authenticates with each service via their public APIs, pulls the new or updated records I specify, and posts them into the matching fields on the second platform. No automatic polling or scheduled jobs are required—the transfer happens only when I launch it. For clarity, here’s what I expect as the final hand-off: • A working script, executable, or lightweight web page with a clear “Run Sync” action. • Configuration file or section where I can store API keys, endpoints, and the field-mapping logic. • Short README explaining prerequisites, setup, and how to extend the mapping if my data model changes. If you prefer a language or framework—Python with requests, Node.js with axios, or similar—feel free to suggest what you’re fastest with, as long as it runs on macOS or in a small Docker container. I’ll provide the two API docs and sample payloads once we start. Let me know your proposed tech stack and timeline, and we can get moving.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40817051, publicado hace 5 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: INR 75,000 - 150,000.

opportunities.title: One-Page Promotional Flyer Design
opportunities.description: I need a polished, single-page flyer that spotlights one of my key products/services and urges new potential customers to pick up the phone or drop us a message. The piece will be sent as a direct mailer, so every inch has to work hard: strong headline, concise benefits, engaging visuals, and a crystal-clear call-to-action with our phone, WhatsApp, and SMS details front and center. You’ll receive the logo, brand colors, core copy points, and a few reference images. From there, I’m counting on your design eye to craft an attention-grabbing layout, select complementary fonts, refine the phrasing where needed, and prepare press-ready artwork. Please keep file sizes DM-friendly and leave safe margins for trimming. Deliverables • Print-ready PDF (CMYK, 300 dpi) • Editable source file (AI, INDD, or PSD) • Web preview JPG/PNG for quick approvals If you’ve created similar direct-response flyers, feel free to share samples so I can gauge style alignment.

opportunities.description: Se busca un profesional o despacho legal especializado para gestionar de principio a fin la protección de contenido digital y la lucha contra la piratería de cursos online de nuestros clientes. El alcance del proyecto incluye: - Gestión de requerimientos y acciones de retirada de tiendas y sitios web que distribuyen o regalan cursos de forma ilegal. Esto implica contactar al infractor, al proveedor de alojamiento, al registrador del dominio, a Cloudflare y a la pasarela de pago. - Eliminación de contenido distribuido ilegalmente en canales y grupos de Telegram, así como en perfiles de redes sociales. - Obligar a la retirada de contenido específico de nuestros clientes, incluso si la web o el canal infractor permanece activo. - Iniciación de acciones legales, tanto por vía penal como civil, contra aquellos que no cumplan con las solicitudes de retirada o reincidan, en el país donde se encuentren, llevando el caso hasta su resolución final. El cliente proporcionará la detección de las infracciones, las pruebas necesarias y los informes técnicos. El profesional legal se encargará de la firma de documentos, la presión legal y la interposición de denuncias. Requisitos imprescindibles. Abogado/a colegiado en ejercicio (indica país, colegio y número). Práctica real en propiedad intelectual o delitos informáticos: cuéntanos dos casos de retirada o denuncia y cómo acabaron. Capacidad para denunciar fuera de tu país, con tu propia red de corresponsales. Tenemos casos abiertos ahora mismo en Perú, México y Colombia. No buscamos servicios de envío masivo de avisos dmca ni perfiles de cumplimiento normativo o rgpd sin práctica en propiedad intelectual. Cómo trabajaremos. Relación estable: cuota mensual para las retiradas y honorarios aparte por cada denuncia. Indica tu tarifa para cada parte y en cuánto tiempo mandarías el primer requerimiento. Para descartar respuestas automáticas, empieza tu propuesta contándonos el último sitio o canal pirata que conseguiste cerrar. Categoría: Legal Tiempo requerido: De 5 a 20 horas

opportunities.title: Bybit Crypto Signal Strategy Integration
opportunities.description: Looking for a Profitable Crypto Trading Strategy, Signal Module or Existing Trading System – Bybit **Budget: $1,000 USD – Fixed Price** ### Project Overview I am looking for an experienced developer or quantitative trader who can provide, develop or adapt a **profitable cryptocurrency trading strategy or signal-generation system** for Bybit USDT perpetual futures. I am particularly interested in identifying LONG and SHORT trading opportunities with the potential for **significant price movements, preferably 5% or more**. I am completely open to different trading approaches. You may propose: - An existing, proven trading strategy. - A ready-made trading signal module or algorithm. - An established trading system that can be adapted to Bybit. - A custom-developed quantitative trading strategy. - A combination of existing tools, indicators and models. **You do not need to develop everything from scratch.** The most important requirement is that the solution demonstrates a genuine, reproducible trading edge. ### What I Am Looking For The system should: - Identify potentially profitable LONG and SHORT opportunities. - Focus on substantial market movements rather than small, random price fluctuations. - Generate actionable signals early enough to capture meaningful profit potential. - Monitor a broad selection of Bybit USDT perpetual markets. - Minimize false signals and avoid entering trades after most of the movement has already occurred. - Operate automatically and reliably. - Be suitable for integration with my existing Python trading bot. I am not requiring any specific indicator, trading model, timeframe or technical architecture. The developer is responsible for selecting the most effective approach. ### Existing Trading Bot I already have a Python trading bot with trade execution, risk management and position management. The proposed solution only needs to generate trading signals and integrate with this existing system. It must not replace or modify the bot's existing trade execution, position sizing, leverage or exit logic. ### Performance Verification **Claims of profitability must be supported by verifiable evidence.** The selected solution must undergo realistic historical backtesting using the existing bot's execution and exit rules. Final historical acceptance requirements: - At least 100 independent, fully closed out-of-sample LONG trades. - At least 100 independent, fully closed out-of-sample SHORT trades. - Profit factor of at least 1.50 separately for LONG and SHORT. - Positive net expectancy for both directions after realistic trading costs. - Maximum portfolio drawdown of 15%. - Positive overall net results after excluding the five largest winning trades. - No lookahead bias, cherry-picking or unrealistic execution assumptions. The final strategy must be frozen before testing on untouched out-of-sample data. Existing strategies and ready-made modules are welcome, but they must meet the same verification requirements. ### Demo Trading and Delivery After successful historical validation and integration, the system must complete: - Four full weeks of Bybit Demo Trading. - Verification of actual signal generation and execution. - Comparison between historical and Demo Trading performance. - Ten business days of independent technical review. The final delivery must include the complete working system, source code, configuration, documentation and reproducible test results. ### Budget and Payment The total budget is **$1,000 USD, fixed and all-inclusive**. One Freelancer escrow milestone may be funded upfront. No partial milestone releases. Final payment is made after successful completion and acceptance of all agreed requirements, subject to Freelancer's escrow and dispute-resolution rules. Future profitability cannot be guaranteed. Acceptance is based on the specified, independently verifiable historical and Demo Trading results. ### When Applying Please briefly explain: 1. Do you already have a profitable strategy, trading module or existing system that could be used for this project? 2. What historical or live trading results can you provide as evidence? 3. What makes your approach suitable for identifying substantial cryptocurrency price movements? 4. Can your solution integrate with an existing Python/Bybit trading bot? 5. Do you accept the $1,000 fixed budget and all verification, Demo Trading and payment conditions? **I welcome both developers with proven existing solutions and experienced quantitative developers who can build a new one.** I am interested in verifiable performance, not promises or a particular trading methodology.

opportunities.title: Ongoing SolidWorks 3D Design
opportunities.description: I’m looking to build a steady collaboration with a SolidWorks specialist who can jump in whenever new projects land on my desk. My day-to-day need is clear: 3D part and assembly design for mechanical parts and full machine assemblies. I will supply either a clean 3D SolidWorks model that needs refinement or a quick hand sketch with key dimensions; you turn that input into fully detailed, parametric assemblies ready for manufacturing. Typical workflow • Receive my reference (model or sketch) • Create or update the parametric part files and mate them into a clean, structured assembly • Generate manufacturing-ready drawings with views, dimensions, tolerances, and a basic BOM • Return the native SolidWorks files, STEP/IGES for sharing, and PDFs of the 2D drawings Acceptance criteria • Feature tree remains fully editable and logically organized • All mates solve without errors; no suppressed features in the final assembly • Drawings follow ISO or ANSI standards (I’ll specify per job) and clearly communicate GD&T where needed Quick communication and the ability to handle iterative feedback are more valuable to me than sheer speed. If you’re comfortable owning the 3D design side so I can focus on overall project management, let’s start with a small assignment and grow from there.

opportunities.title: Looking for a Startup Launch Consultant / Business Setup Specialist
opportunities.description: # Looking for a Startup Launch Consultant / Business Setup Specialist **Project: Build and Launch an Outsourced Business Solutions Marketplace for Indian MSMEs** I'm looking for an experienced startup consultant, business strategist or business launch operator who can help me conceptualise, structure and set up a new business from scratch. ### 1. Business Idea I want to launch a business that provides a wide range of professional services to small and medium-sized businesses (MSMEs) across India. The business will operate on an asset-light, freelancer-powered model. The concept is simple: - Identify common business requirements of MSMEs. - Offer these services through our own company. - Acquire customers through direct outreach, digital marketing and partnerships. - Source qualified freelancers and specialist agencies to execute the work. - Manage client relationships, pricing, quality control and delivery. - Earn revenue through service markups, commissions and recurring monthly contracts. Essentially, we will act as the single point of contact for businesses that need professional services without hiring full-time employees or managing multiple vendors. ### 2. Services We Want to Explore I want you to research and identify the most commercially viable services, including: - Website and e-commerce development. - Digital marketing and social media management. - Branding, graphic design and video editing. - AI implementation and business automation. - WhatsApp automation and CRM implementation. - Accounting, bookkeeping and MIS support. - Recruitment and HR outsourcing. - Business documentation and presentations. - Market research and data analytics. - Customer support outsourcing. - Engineering and design services. - Business consulting and operational support. You should not blindly include all these categories. Research the Indian MSME market and recommend which services have the strongest demand, margins, repeat business potential and ease of execution. ### 3. What I Expect You to Build I am looking for end-to-end business setup, not just a business plan or PowerPoint presentation. **A. Business Strategy** - Research the Indian MSME market. - Identify target customer segments. - Study competitors and existing service marketplaces. - Finalise the business positioning and revenue model. - Identify 10–15 initial services to launch. - Develop a pricing and profitability strategy. **B. Freelancer Supply Network** - Identify suitable freelancers and agencies across India. - Source freelancers through Upwork, Fiverr, Freelancer and other channels. - Shortlist and evaluate service providers. - Create a verified freelancer database. - Establish freelancer pricing, commissions and payment terms. - Develop onboarding and quality-control processes. **C. Service Packaging and Pricing** - Create standardised service packages. - Define deliverables, timelines and revision policies. - Calculate freelancer costs and our selling prices. - Design project-based and monthly subscription offerings. - Create quotation and proposal templates. **D. Business Infrastructure** - Recommend a suitable business name and positioning. - Set up the business website and service catalogue. - Create enquiry and requirement collection forms. - Set up a CRM and lead management process. - Create project tracking and delivery dashboards. - Set up invoicing, payment collection and freelancer payment workflows. - Prepare client agreements and freelancer agreements. **E. Customer Acquisition System** - Identify the best channels to acquire MSME customers. - Create prospect databases and lead lists. - Develop WhatsApp, email and LinkedIn outreach strategies. - Prepare sales scripts, proposals and pitch decks. - Create a repeatable customer acquisition process. - Develop a strategy to acquire the first 10 paying customers. **F. Operational Playbook** - Document the complete process from customer enquiry to project delivery. - Define how projects will be allocated to freelancers. - Establish quality checks and client approval processes. - Create escalation and issue-resolution procedures. - Build a system that I can independently operate after the handover. ### 4. Expected Final Deliverables At the end of the engagement, I should have: 1. A validated business model and market research report. 2. A clear business positioning and service catalogue. 3. A database of at least 30–50 shortlisted freelancers across selected categories. 4. Service-wise pricing and profit margin calculations. 5. A functional business website. 6. CRM and project management setup. 7. Sales and customer acquisition templates. 8. Client and freelancer onboarding systems. 9. Documented operational processes and SOPs. 10. A 90-day business execution roadmap. 11. A complete handover so I can independently manage the business. Where feasible, I also want you to help execute initial customer outreach and support the first few client acquisitions. Do not simply provide theoretical recommendations. ### 5. Ideal Candidate I'm looking for someone who: - Has experience launching service-based businesses or marketplaces. - Understands the Indian MSME ecosystem. - Has experience working with freelancers and outsourced delivery teams. - Understands business development, pricing and unit economics. - Can build systems and processes from scratch. - Has practical experience acquiring paying customers. - Can independently manage the setup and implementation. A consultant who has previously built an agency, outsourcing business or freelancer-powered service company would be ideal. ### 6. Engagement Structure I prefer a milestone-based engagement with clearly defined deliverables. Please share: - Your proposed execution strategy. - Relevant businesses or projects you have launched. - What you will personally execute versus outsource. - Estimated timeline. - Complete project fee. - Any additional operational or software costs. - What will be included in the final handover. **Important:** I'm not looking for someone to write a business plan and disappear. I want someone who can take ownership of setting up the business infrastructure, supply network, service offerings and operating systems so that I can take over a functioning business and focus on growing revenue. Looking forward to working with the right person.

observed_data.verbatim_request: "# Looking for a Startup Launch Consultant / Business Setup Specialist **Project: Build and Launch an Outsourced Business Solutions Marketplace for Indian MSMEs** I'm looking for an experienced startup consultant, business strategist or business launch operator who can help me conceptualise, structure and set up a new business from scratch. ### 1. Business Idea I want to launch a business that provides a wide range of professional services to small and medium-sized businesses (MSMEs) across India. The business will operate on an asset-light, freelancer-powered model. The concept is simple: - Identify common business requirements of MSMEs. - Offer these services through our own company. - Acquire customers through direct outreach, digital marketing and partnerships. - Source qualified freelancers and specialist agencies to execute the work. - Manage client relationships, pricing, quality control and delivery. - Earn revenue through service markups, commissions and recurring monthly contracts. Essentially, we will act as the single point of contact for businesses that need professional services without hiring full-time employees or managing multiple vendors. ### 2. Services We Want to Explore I want you to research and identify the most commercially viable services, including: - Website and e-commerce development. - Digital marketing and social media management. - Branding, graphic design and video editing. - AI implementation and business automation. - WhatsApp automation and CRM implementation. - Accounting, bookkeeping and MIS support. - Recruitment and HR outsourcing. - Business documentation and presentations. - Market research and data analytics. - Customer support outsourcing. - Engineering and design services. - Business consulting and operational support. You should not blindly include all these categories. Research the Indian MSME market and recommend which services have the strongest demand, margins, repeat business potential and ease of execution. ### 3. What I Expect You to Build I am looking for end-to-end business setup, not just a business plan or PowerPoint presentation. **A. Business Strategy** - Research the Indian MSME market. - Identify target customer segments. - Study competitors and existing service marketplaces. - Finalise the business positioning and revenue model. - Identify 10–15 initial services to launch. - Develop a pricing and profitability strategy. **B. Freelancer Supply Network** - Identify suitable freelancers and agencies across India. - Source freelancers through Upwork, Fiverr, Freelancer and other channels. - Shortlist and evaluate service providers. - Create a verified freelancer database. - Establish freelancer pricing, commissions and payment terms. - Develop onboarding and quality-control processes. **C. Service Packaging and Pricing** - Create standardised service packages. - Define deliverables, timelines and revision policies. - Calculate freelancer costs and our selling prices. - Design project-based and monthly subscription offerings. - Create quotation and proposal templates. **D. Business Infrastructure** - Recommend a suitable business name and positioning. - Set up the business website and service catalogue. - Create enquiry and requirement collection forms. - Set up a CRM and lead management process. - Create project tracking and delivery dashboards. - Set up invoicing, payment collection and freelancer payment workflows. - Prepare client agreements and freelancer agreements. **E. Customer Acquisition System** - Identify the best channels to acquire MSME customers. - Create prospect databases and lead lists. - Develop WhatsApp, email and LinkedIn outreach strategies. - Prepare sales scripts, proposals and pitch decks. - Create a repeatable customer acquisition process. - Develop a strategy to acquire the first 10 paying customers. **F. Operational Playbook** - Document the complete process from customer enquiry to project delivery. - Define how projects will be allocated to freelancers. - Establish quality checks and client approval processes. - Create escalation and issue-resolution procedures. - Build a system that I can independently operate after the handover. ### 4. Expected Final Deliverables At the end of the engagement, I should have: 1. A validated business model and market research report. 2. A clear business positioning and service catalogue. 3. A database of at least 30–50 shortlisted freelancers across selected categories. 4. Service-wise pricing and profit margin calculations. 5. A functional business website. 6. CRM and project management setup. 7. Sales and customer acquisition templates. 8. Client and freelancer onboarding systems. 9. Documented operational processes and SOPs. 10. A 90-day business execution roadmap. 11. A complete handover so I can independently manage the business. Where feasible, I also want you to help execute initial customer outreach and support the first few client acquisitions. Do not simply provide theoretical recommendations. ### 5. Ideal Candidate I'm looking for someone who: - Has experience launching service-based businesses or marketplaces. - Understands the Indian MSME ecosystem. - Has experience working with freelancers and outsourced delivery teams. - Understands business development, pricing and unit economics. - Can build systems and processes from scratch. - Has practical experience acquiring paying customers. - Can independently manage the setup and implementation. A consultant who has previously built an agency, outsourcing business or freelancer-powered service company would be ideal. ### 6. Engagement Structure I prefer a milestone-based engagement with clearly defined deliverables. Please share: - Your proposed execution strategy. - Relevant businesses or projects you have launched. - What you will personally execute versus outsource. - Estimated timeline. - Complete project fee. - Any additional operational or software costs. - What will be included in the final handover. **Important:** I'm not looking for someone to write a business plan and disappear. I want someone who can take ownership of setting up the business infrastructure, supply network, service offerings and operating systems so that I can take over a functioning business and focus on growing revenue. Looking forward to working with the right person."

opportunities.title: Long Term CAD expert
opportunities.description: I manage a continual flow of projects that call for fast, precise CAD work and I want to build an ongoing relationship with a specialist who can step in whenever new drawings or models are required. Typical assignments range from cleaning up rough hand sketches to updating existing CAD files or producing fully detailed 3D parts ready for fabrication, so versatility across 2D drafting and 3D modelling will be important. Turnaround times vary—some jobs need same-day edits while larger pieces may stretch over several weeks—but clear communication and consistent file naming are a must on every task. I use AutoCAD and SolidWorks most often, yet I am open to other mainstream platforms as long as deliverables arrive in the formats my fabricators and clients expect. Deliverables (as each job dictates): • Native CAD file (.dwg, .sldprt/.sldasm, STEP, or similar) • Dimensioned PDF sheets or plotted drawings ready for print or permit submission • If requested, high-resolution renders or exploded views for presentations Please let me know your preferred software, how you like to receive source information, and your typical response time so we can establish a smooth workflow from day one.

opportunities.title: Customer Service Toko Online
opportunities.description: Saya ingin memperkuat layanan pelanggan untuk toko online saya dan membutuhkan seseorang yang fokus menangani chat serta pertanyaan pelanggan setiap hari. Mayoritas interaksi datang melalui WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, dan marketplace seperti Shopee atau Tokopedia. Tanggung jawab utama: • Membalas pesan secepat mungkin, menjaga nada ramah dan informatif. • Menjawab seputar informasi produk, harga, dan ketersediaan stok. • Membimbing pelanggan mengenai cara pemesanan, pembayaran, serta pengiriman. • Menangani keluhan, retur, atau masalah pesanan dengan solusi yang tepat dan sopan. Harapan kerja: – Respons maksimal 5-10 menit selama jam operasional. – Gunakan catatan internal atau dashboard marketplace untuk melacak status setiap pertanyaan. – Membuat ringkasan harian singkat tentang jumlah chat masuk, isu yang terselesaikan, dan saran perbaikan proses. Jika Anda terbiasa berkomunikasi lewat WhatsApp Business, fitur DM Instagram/Facebook, dan panel chat marketplace, serta mampu menjaga kepuasan pelanggan, saya menantikan kolaborasi kita.
