opportunities.title: Full-Stack Website Platform Overhaul
opportunities.description: Senior Full-Stack Developer — Complete Website Audit, Rebuild, Automation, CRM, SEO & Business Platform Integration Company: NEVIE-GLOBAL Websites: nevie-global.fr / nevie-global.com Project: Complete technical and commercial transformation of TWO existing websites Total Fixed Budget: USD 120 — Non-negotiable Payment: 100% AFTER complete delivery, testing and written acceptance Advance Payment: NONE Duration: Maximum 20 working days Location: Worldwide — Remote PROJECT OVERVIEW NEVIE-GLOBAL is looking for a highly skilled Full-Stack Developer or a small technical team to completely audit, repair, modernize, optimize, integrate and finalize our two existing corporate websites. Both websites already exist, with source code and infrastructure available. This is a complete technical, functional, commercial and automation upgrade — not simply a website redesign. The developer must reuse existing components wherever possible, correct defective functionality, complete missing features and deliver two fully operational commercial platforms. 1. COMPLETE TECHNICAL AUDIT — BOTH WEBSITES * Full source-code and architecture review. * GitHub repository and branch audit. * Frontend and backend verification. * Database structure and connectivity. * API and webhook inspection. * Hosting and deployment verification. * Broken links, buttons, pages and forms. * Authentication and authorization review. * Security vulnerabilities and configuration weaknesses. * Mobile and cross-browser compatibility. * SEO and accessibility analysis. * Performance and loading-speed evaluation. * Code duplication and technical debt identification. * Dependency and package review. * Error logging and monitoring verification. * Complete prioritized technical audit report. 2. FULL REPAIR, MODERNIZATION & UI/UX * Fix all agreed technical defects. * Restore broken or incomplete features. * Modernize website design and navigation. * Improve mobile, tablet and desktop responsiveness. * Optimize page speed and resource loading. * Improve typography, layouts and visual consistency. * Apply NEVIE-GLOBAL brand guidelines. * Repair forms and database connections. * Improve error handling. * Remove unnecessary code and dependencies. * Ensure consistent functionality across both websites. * Optimize accessibility and usability. * Deliver professional, production-ready interfaces. 3. SIX COMMERCIAL WEBSITE PACKAGES Implement and optimize the following packages: 1. Landing Page. 2. Starter. 3. Business. 4. Business Pro. 5. E-commerce. 6. Premium. Each package must include: * Professional presentation. * Complete features and benefits. * Approved pricing. * Comparison tables. * Optional services. * Functional quotation buttons. * Responsive layouts. * Editable commercial information. * Customer conversion optimization. 4. ADVANCED QUOTATION & CUSTOMER ACQUISITION SYSTEM Develop a complete quotation management process: * Dynamic package selection. * Customer and company identification. * Project requirements questionnaire. * Conditional fields and service options. * Budget and timeline information. * Secure document uploads. * Automatic request registration. * Unique quotation reference. * Email confirmation. * Administrator notification. * Customer request tracking. * Request status management. * Spam protection and form validation. * Data export. * CRM-ready structure. * Complete end-to-end testing. 5. CRM & COMMERCIAL AUTOMATION * Centralized lead collection. * Lead qualification fields. * Customer and prospect database. * Commercial pipeline tracking. * Automated email notifications. * Follow-up reminders. * Customer history. * Lead source tracking. * Dashboard of incoming requests. * CSV export. * API-ready CRM integration. * Duplicate lead detection. * Secure administrative management. 6. ADMINISTRATIVE DASHBOARD Build or improve a centralized administration interface covering: * Website content management. * Commercial package management. * Prices and options. * Customer inquiries. * Quotation requests. * Lead management. * Contact form submissions. * Basic website statistics. * User access and permissions. * Activity logs. * Error reporting. * Secure authentication. 7. SEO, ANALYTICS & CONVERSION OPTIMIZATION * Technical SEO audit and corrections. * Meta titles and descriptions. * Heading structure. * XML sitemap. * Robots.txt configuration. * Canonical URLs. * Structured data where relevant. * Image optimization. * Internal linking. * Mobile SEO. * Analytics integration. * Conversion event tracking. * Cookie consent integration where required. * Search engine indexing verification. * Basic conversion optimization. 8. SECURITY, PRIVACY & DATA PROTECTION * HTTPS and SSL verification. * Secure authentication. * Role-based permissions. * Input validation. * Protection against common web vulnerabilities. * Secure file uploads. * Secret and environment variable protection. * Database access review. * Basic rate limiting. * Security headers. * Backup verification. * Error logging. * Privacy-friendly form handling. * Integration of approved legal and privacy documents. 9. AUTOMATION & API INTEGRATION * Connect forms to automated workflows. * Email notification automation. * Webhook integrations. * API connectivity. * CRM integration readiness. * n8n integration where existing infrastructure allows. * Automated lead registration. * Automated customer confirmations. * Error handling and retry mechanisms. * Integration documentation. * Reusable workflow components. 10. INFRASTRUCTURE & DEPLOYMENT * GitHub code management. * Hostinger hosting integration. * Production deployment. * DNS configuration review. * SSL verification. * Database connectivity. * Environment configuration. * Deployment troubleshooting. * Basic automated deployment where feasible. * Backup and recovery instructions. * Production stability verification. No migration to Vercel. 11. INTERNATIONAL & MULTILINGUAL CONSISTENCY * Audit French and international website versions. * Correct translation inconsistencies. * Ensure coherent commercial messaging. * Verify language navigation. * Check localized metadata. * Maintain consistent branding. * Verify localized forms and customer notifications. * Ensure correct internal links between language versions. 12. TESTING, DOCUMENTATION & FINAL DELIVERY Required deliverables: * Full audit report for both websites. * Corrected source code. * Two operational production websites. * Six commercial packages implemented. * Complete quotation system. * Functional lead management. * Administrative dashboard. * SEO and performance improvements. * Security corrections. * Automation and API integrations. * Mobile and desktop testing. * Functional test report. * Technical documentation. * Deployment instructions. * Final demonstration. * All code committed to NEVIE-GLOBAL repositories. * 30 days of corrective maintenance after acceptance. STRICT PAYMENT CONDITIONS TOTAL PROJECT PRICE: USD 120 FIXED. * No advance payment. * No partial payment. * No upfront milestone release. * No additional development fees. * No mandatory paid third-party subscriptions. * One single payment after full delivery. * All deliverables must be demonstrated and tested. * NEVIE-GLOBAL must formally accept the completed project before payment release. * Payment must be handled securely through Freelancer.com. * Project funds may be secured through the platform’s escrow system, subject to platform rules. * All paid deliverables and intellectual property rights must be transferred according to the agreed contract. Do not apply if you require an advance payment or cannot accept the USD 120 total fixed budget. CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS * Strong Full-Stack development experience. * Existing website repair and modernization. * GitHub. * Hostinger. * JavaScript / TypeScript. * React or equivalent. * Node.js and/or Python. * Database and API integration. * CRM and automation. * Technical SEO. * Web security. * Professional documentation. * Proven delivery experience. REQUIRED APPLICATION ANSWERS 1. Can you complete the entire scope for USD 120 fixed? 2. Do you accept one payment only after full delivery, testing and written approval? 3. Can you complete the project within 20 working days? 4. Have you worked with GitHub and Hostinger? 5. Can you repair existing code without rebuilding unnecessarily? 6. Can you implement quotation, CRM and administration systems? 7. Can you integrate existing APIs and n8n workflows? 8. Will you provide 30 days of corrective maintenance? 9. Are you working individually or with a team? 10. Can you provide verifiable examples of similar completed projects? Applications that do not explicitly accept the fixed budget, payment conditions and complete scope will not be considered. NEVIE-GLOBAL is looking for a reliable technical collaborator who can deliver complete, functional and verified results.

opportunities.title: Animator for Parenting YouTube Stories
opportunities.description: ## Hiring: 2D / 3D Animator for Parenting YouTube Videos We are looking for a creative **2D/3D animator or AI video creator** to produce high-quality, engaging animated videos for a new parenting and early-childhood development YouTube channel. ### About the Content Our videos will feature relatable, everyday parenting situations involving children aged 2–6, such as: - A child refusing food or throwing food from their plate. - A toddler having a tantrum in a supermarket. - A child hitting, shouting, or refusing to listen. - Children struggling to share toys or interact with others. Each video will explain the parenting challenge, what parents can do in the moment, and practical approaches to help children over time. ### Animation Style We are open to **2D, 2.5D, or stylized 3D animation**, including AI-assisted production. What matters most: - Cute, expressive characters with believable emotions. - Visually engaging, relatable parenting scenarios. - Consistent character designs across multiple episodes. - Smooth storytelling, natural movements, and polished visuals. - A warm, playful style with occasional humor. We are **not looking for basic slideshow animations or generic corporate explainer videos.** ### Project Requirements - **Video length:** 5 -10 minutes. - **Budget:** ₹5,000–₹10,000 per completed video. - **Volume:** Initially 2–4 videos per month, with potential for ongoing work. - **Deliverables:** Full HD videos with animation, voiceover, sound effects, background music, and editing. - Ability to repurpose footage into YouTube Shorts and Instagram Reels. - Commercial usage rights and original or properly licensed assets. AI tools such as Higgsfield, Kling, Runway, or similar are welcome if the final output meets our quality standards. ### When Applying, Please Share 1. Samples of similar 2D/3D animated storytelling videos. 2. Your cost for a complete five-minute video. 3. Which animation tools and workflows you use. 4. Whether scripting, voiceover, music, and revisions are included. 5. How you maintain character consistency across episodes. 6. Your typical turnaround time. **We are looking for a long-term creative partner who can help us develop a distinctive, recognizable animation style and produce high-quality videos consistently within budget.**

opportunities.title: Technical bag/carry-system design
opportunities.description: Project Details I'm looking for an experienced product designer to develop the design and technical documentation for a premium technical equipment travel bag. The product is intended to accommodate technical equipment, including laptops, mechanical keyboards, headphones and accessories. I have already undertaken customer research and developed an initial product specification. I'm now looking for someone to review and validate the product architecture, explore design concepts and develop a resolved design package. A key aspect of the project is the internal architecture, particularly the development of a structured, configurable modular organisation system. This may involve rigid or semi-rigid components, removable dividers and protective internal structures. The initial scope will include: Review and validation of the existing product specification. Product architecture and construction recommendations. Exploration of alternative design concepts. Development of the preferred design direction. Initial 3D CAD modelling and technical drawings. Material, component and construction recommendations. Technical documentation suitable for handover to a separate product engineer. Important: Physical prototyping and detailed production engineering will be commissioned separately in the UK. This engagement is focused on architecture, design and CAD development. Please share examples of relevant products you have personally designed, particularly technical bags, luggage, protective cases or products incorporating modular internal structures. Please also outline your proposed approach, deliverables and relevant experience.

opportunities.title: Ongoing WordPress/WooCommerce Development
opportunities.description: **Ongoing WordPress/WooCommerce Backend Development** I manage two established WordPress websites built with Avada and WooCommerce. I handle front-end design, SEO, digital marketing, and project management. I'm seeking an experienced, dependable backend developer for ongoing technical assistance as needed. **Immediate Priorities** Our primary focus is developing and refining membership, subscription, and digital product functionality, including: - WooCommerce membership and subscription configuration - Protected content, digital downloads, and access permissions - Membership levels and recurring payment functionality - Customer account management, renewals, and cancellations - Secure digital product delivery and payment gateway integrations - Automated customer notifications and transactional emails **Additional Development Needs** Future projects may include CRM integrations, workflow automation, API connections, custom PHP development, WordPress hooks, plugin configuration, performance optimization, troubleshooting, and general backend improvements. **Working Relationship** I'm looking for a reliable, affordable developer interested in a long-term professional relationship. Work will be assigned on an as-needed basis, with hours determined by project requirements, available client budgets, and the developer's hourly rate. I will continue managing the front end, client relationships, SEO, and overall project direction. The developer will focus primarily on backend functionality, integrations, and technical implementation. **Confidentiality and Initial Consultation** Before sharing client identities, proprietary information, project documentation, or website access, a signed Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) will be required. I would like to initially meet with qualified candidates to discuss their experience, technical capabilities, availability, and compatibility with our projects before assigning work. **Please Include in Your Proposal:** - Your hourly rate and general availability - Examples of relevant WordPress and WooCommerce development projects - Experience with membership and subscription plugins - Experience with custom PHP, integrations, and troubleshooting - Your willingness to sign an NDA I'm looking for someone who communicates clearly, works independently, respects deadlines, and can become a dependable technical resource as these projects continue to grow.

opportunities.title: Outlook Support Email Organizer
opportunities.description: I need an automated workflow inside our Microsoft 365 Outlook mailbox that will sort and label every customer-support email the moment it arrives. The sole focus is intelligent triage—no auto-replying—so my team can jump straight to solving issues instead of digging through an inbox. Current setup • All support messages land in a single Outlook address hosted on Microsoft 365. • We want each incoming email analysed and immediately filed, tagged, or colour-categorised according to clear, consistent rules (topic, urgency, order reference, or any additional cues you recommend). What I’m after You may build this with native Outlook rules, Power Automate flows, a lightweight add-in, or a custom script that uses the Microsoft Graph API—whichever delivers reliable, maintenance-friendly results. Non-technical staff must be able to tweak categories or rules without touching code, and the solution needs to run 24/7 in the cloud. Deliverables 1. Fully functioning sorting-and-labelling automation connected to our Outlook inbox 2. Short, plain-English documentation showing how to edit or expand the rules 3. A brief live or recorded walkthrough so the team can see everything in action When you respond, please outline your chosen approach, any similar Outlook/M365 automations you’ve built, and what access or information you’ll need from my side to get started.

opportunities.title: Ilustrasi Realistis Domba Terbang
opportunities.description: Saya membutuhkan satu ilustrasi digital beresolusi tinggi yang menampilkan seekor domba terbang melayang di udara dengan gaya realistis—nyaris seperti hasil jepretan kamera. Gambaran adegan yang saya inginkan: • Latar: hamparan padang rumput hijau berpadu pegunungan di kejauhan. • Pencahayaan & suasana: siang hari yang cerah dan damai; langit biru bersih dengan awan tipis lembut. • Subjek utama: domba tampak nyata, proporsi anatomi akurat, tekstur bulu jelas, sorotan cahaya alami. Detail teknis yang perlu dipenuhi: • Format akhir: JPEG dan PNG, minimal 4000 px pada sisi terpendek. • Versi terpisah tanpa latar belakang (transparent PNG) untuk fleksibilitas desain lanjutan. • Warna true-to-life, siap cetak dan tampil maksimal di layar. Silakan gunakan teknik apa pun—digital painting, 3D render fotorealistik, atau photo compositing—asal hasil akhirnya konsisten dengan deskripsi di atas. Berikan juga file sumber (PSD/AI/BLEND atau setara) agar saya bisa menyesuaikan jika diperlukan. Saya akan menilai karya berdasarkan realisme tekstur, komposisi seimbang, dan nuansa damai yang terasa natural. Jika Anda memiliki portofolio serupa, tautkan agar saya dapat melihat kualitas pekerjaan Anda.

Silakan gunakan teknik apa pun—digital painting, 3D render fotorealistik, atau photo compositing—asal hasil akhirnya konsisten dengan deskripsi di atas. Berikan juga file sumber (PSD/AI/BLEND atau setara) agar saya bisa menyesuaikan jika diperlukan. Saya akan menilai karya berdasarkan realisme tekstur, komposisi seimbang, dan nuansa damai yang terasa natural. Jika Anda memiliki portofolio serupa, tautkan agar saya dapat melihat kualitas pekerjaan Anda."

opportunities.title: Industrial Electrical Engineer for AutoCAD Design
opportunities.description: Fully Remote | Contract | $8/hr We're looking for an Electrical Engineer with 3+ years of industrial experience to handle electrical design and documentation for engineered equipment and systems. What You'll Do - Create and review single-line diagrams, load lists, schematics, and wiring diagrams in AutoCAD Electrical. - Select and integrate motors, heaters, instruments, and PLC hardware. - Review vendor drawings and specifications against project requirements and NEC/IEC standards. - Work with vendors, customers, and internal teams on deliverables and schedules. - Provide remote technical support during fabrication, installation, and startup. Must Have - BS in Electrical Engineering or a related field. - 3+ years of industrial electrical engineering experience. - Strong AutoCAD Electrical skills. - Working knowledge of NEC and/or IEC standards. Nice to Have - Background in rotating equipment, skid or packaged equipment, OEM manufacturing, or power generation. - Experience with 3D modeling software. To Apply, Please Send 1. A short summary of your industrial electrical engineering experience. 2. One or two sample drawings or projects (redacted samples are acceptable). 3. Your availability.

opportunities.title: Warm French Presenter For UGC Video
opportunities.description: Goal: a warm and natural UGC-style video presenting CAPTUDES (online tutoring, languages, and kids' clubs), to be used as a paid ad (sponsoring) on Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok. Language: The video must be done fully in fluent French, engaging and warm, targeted at parents. Deliverables: 1. One main video of 30–60 seconds, vertical 9:16 (1080×1920). 2. A short ad cut of 15 seconds. 3. A square version 1:1 (or 4:5) optimized for the Facebook/Instagram feed. 4. Burned-in French subtitles for all versions to ensure ads retain attention when viewed without sound. 5. A clean version without music for flexible use. Content to include: - Script provided in French by the client. - CAPTUDES logo and WhatsApp contact at the end. - Structure: Engaging hook within the first 3 seconds, addressing the challenges parents face, introducing how CAPTUDES can help with small groups, gentle tutors, free level assessments, and ending with a compelling call-to-action (« Écrivez-nous sur WhatsApp pour un bilan gratuit »). Required Rights: The freelancer must grant full commercial usage rights for ongoing paid advertising applications without time restrictions. Additional Info: The focus is on authenticity and quality. The freelancer must confirm comfort in speaking fluent French naturally. Delivery time frames and included revisions should be detailed by the freelancer upon applying.

opportunities.title: Social Media Lead Generation Management
opportunities.description: I run four sister companies—a traditional printing production house, an events agency, a fully serviced business centre, and a government service centre—and I’m ready to put our social channels to work. The first brands on the runway are the business centre and the government service arm; once we’ve built a steady flow of inquiries there, we’ll layer in the printing and events divisions. The single outcome that matters most to me is more qualified customer inquiries, whether they arrive as direct messages, WhatsApp chats, or phone calls. Every story, carousel, reel, or paid ad you craft should be engineered toward that conversion goal. You’ll own the full social funnel: strategy, content calendar, creative production, community management, paid campaigns in Meta Ads Manager, and performance tracking via native insights or Google Analytics. I’ll supply logos, service details, and on-site footage; you bring thumb-stopping copy, design skills (Canva, Adobe, or your tool of choice), and the data mindset to refine targeting and cost per lead. To shortlist quickly I only need one thing from you—proof. Share past pages, campaigns, or reports that show you’ve generated measurable leads for other businesses. A few numbers speak louder than a lengthy proposal. Pilot scope (first month) • Content plan and branded creatives for Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn • Lead-generation ad set optimised for “Send Message” and “Call Now” objectives • Weekly insights report outlining inquiry volume, CPL, and next-step tweaks If we hit the KPIs we set together, we’ll roll straight into a longer engagement and expand coverage to TikTok, YouTube, and Google Ads, plus include the printing and events firms. Show me your past work that proves you can turn impressions into real conversations, and let’s get started.

opportunities.title: Super Realistic 3D Street Visualization
opportunities.description: I need a complete 3D scene of an urban street aimed at high-end architectural visualisations. The street must feel alive and convincingly real: detailed asphalt with subtle wear, marked parking bays, textured curbs, convincing road markings, realistic sidewalks, street furniture, dynamic lighting and reflections, plus a believable mix of parked and moving vehicles. Surrounding the roadway I want continuous rows of urban façades—shops, offices or apartment blocks—modelled and textured with the same level of care so that when I frame a camera at street level everything reads as one coherent environment. Daytime lighting is the priority, but the materials and shaders should react properly if I later introduce night or dusk HDRIs. Deliverables • Production-ready 3D file (Blender, 3ds Max, Maya or similar) with organised layers and named objects • All textures, PBR materials and HDRIs used, clearly linked • A short turntable or still set that demonstrates the final lighting and realism I’ll review the work on accuracy of scale, texture quality, lighting realism and overall cohesion of the scene. Let me know which software and render engine you prefer so we can align settings from the start.

opportunities.title: Laravel Developer Needed for Easy Inventory management work
opportunities.description: New Freelancer needed at Low Budget for Long Term. I’m working on an inventory-focused application built with Laravel and need an extra set of hands to push several improvements over the line. The core codebase is stable, but a few modules still lack the polish and functionality required for smooth day-to-day stock handling. Here’s the current situation: • Incoming and outgoing stock movements display correctly, yet the underlying logic for adjustments and returns is incomplete. • Product, supplier, and purchase-order models exist, though relationships need refining and validation rules expanded. • Basic reports render in Blade, but I want dynamic, exportable PDFs and CSVs generated through queued jobs to keep the UI responsive. Your role will be to extend the existing controllers, write clean Eloquent queries, create or tweak migrations where data structures fall short, and tighten up the user experience in the views. I’m on Laravel 10, PHP 8.2, MySQL 8, and use Git for version control; familiarity with these is essential.

opportunities.title: Instagram & Facebook Brand Growth
opportunities.description: My Instagram and Facebook pages need a consistent, strategic push so they start working as true brand-building assets. The priority is clear: build awareness and trust with people who live near my business. To do that, I want our feeds to showcase short, eye-catching videos and reels that feel native to each platform while still reflecting my brand voice. Here is what I see us working on together: • A monthly content calendar focused on reels, Stories, and occasional carousel posts, all optimised for local reach and high engagement • Creative production of each asset—scripting, design, editing, and on-brand captions with strong calls to action • Geo-targeted ad campaigns in Meta Ads Manager that amplify our best-performing content and drive qualified traffic to my DMs, WhatsApp, and dedicated lead forms • Weekly optimisation using Instagram Insights and Facebook Analytics so we can double down on the formats and hooks that grow the fastest • Transparent reporting every two weeks outlining follower growth, reach, saves, shares, and—most importantly—how perceptions of the brand are improving through comments and messages I’m happy to supply raw footage, product shots, and any brand guidelines you need. You’ll bring the creative polish, analytics know-how, and reliability to keep the schedule humming even when I’m busy elsewhere in the business. If this sounds like the kind of partnership you enjoy, tell me a little about similar local campaigns you’ve managed and the results you achieved. I’m ready to get started as soon as we agree on the first month’s plan.

El alcance incluye: Cruzar y comparar datos PRE vs. POST: Emparejar las respuestas de antes y después mediante un código anónimo único por participante para medir la evolución real en empatía, percepción de riesgo y actitud ante el ciberacoso. Calcular indicadores clave y gráficos: Generar resúmenes visuales con porcentajes, comparativas antes/después y los 3 indicadores principales del programa (Índice de Tolerancia a la Violencia Digital, Tasa de Activación del Espectador y Mapa de Riesgo por plataformas). Entregable ejecutivo: Entregar un informe visual exportable (PDF o PPT) con las gráficas listas para incluir en un dossier institucional, junto con una breve guía de interpretación y el archivo fuente automatizado. Requisitos valorables:Experiencia previa analizando cuestionarios PRE/POST o estudios de impacto social/educativo.Buen criterio de visualización de datos (gráficos comparativos limpios y fáciles de entender por perfiles no técnicos).Rigor en el manejo de datos anonimizados y capacidad para documentar el proceso de forma sencilla.

opportunities.title: WhatsApp Order-Booking Bot Creation
opportunities.description: I need a fully-functional WhatsApp agent that can guide customers through placing an order or making a booking without any manual intervention from my side. The flow should welcome the user, present the available items or time slots, collect their choices, confirm the details, and then forward the complete order or booking information to me in real time—email, webhook, or a simple dashboard are all acceptable as long as the data arrives reliably. Key expectations • Runs on the official WhatsApp Business API (or a reliable provider such as Twilio) so the solution stays compliant and scalable. • Clear, conversational message flows that can be edited later, preferably through a simple JSON file or visual interface. • Automatic error handling and fallback to a human hand-off when the bot cannot understand a request. • Quick setup: I would like the first working version live and testable as soon as possible. Deliverables 1. Deployable source code or cloud-hosted project. 2. Step-by-step deployment guide. 3. Short video or live demo that proves the ordering / booking journey works end-to-end. When you respond, include a detailed project proposal that outlines the tech stack, timeline, and any previous experience with WhatsApp Business API integrations.

Your task is strictly data analysis—no template building or VBA automation—using the full power of formulas, pivot tables, Power Query, or any native Excel feature that speeds up accurate number-crunching. I will supply the raw workbook along with a short brief on the business context. From there, I expect you to organise the data properly, apply the right analytical techniques, and deliver an easy-to-follow summary that highlights what the numbers actually mean for the business. opportunities.title: Comercial freelance a comisión en Madrid – Captación de negocios locales
opportunities.description: En The Why Reworks (TWR) gestionamos publicidad digital (Meta Ads, Google Ads y TikTok Ads) para negocios locales y marcas emergentes en Madrid: restaurantes, cafeterías, peluquerías, centros de estética, tiendas de moda, estudios de fitness… Buscamos comerciales freelance en Madrid que nos presenten negocios con los que podamos trabajar. TU TRABAJO - Identificar negocios de Madrid (preferiblemente dentro de la M-30) que puedan beneficiarse de la publicidad digital. - Contactarlos por teléfono, en persona o a través de tu propia red de contactos. - Conseguir una primera llamada entre el dueño o responsable y nosotros. El cierre, la propuesta y la gestión del cliente los hacemos nosotros. REMUNERACIÓN - 100% a comisión: 20% recurrente sobre lo que factura cada cliente que traigas, cada mes, mientras siga con nosotros. - Con nuestra tarifa estándar (400 €/mes + IVA), son 80 €/mes por cliente activo. Con 10 clientes activos, 800 €/mes recurrentes. - Sin objetivos mínimos ni horarios. TE DAMOS - Presentación del servicio, precios claros e informe de ejemplo. - Un servicio fácil de explicar: precio fijo, sin permanencias largas y sin promesas imposibles. BUSCAMOS - Residencia en Madrid o contacto habitual con negocios de Madrid. - Experiencia vendiendo a pequeños negocios (hostelería, belleza, retail…) o una buena red de contactos en ese sector. - Trato cercano y honesto. No buscamos venta agresiva. - Valorable: conocer el marketing o la publicidad digital, o trabajar ya con estos negocios (fotografía, diseño, distribución, asesoría…). IMPORTANTE: el contacto con los negocios debe hacerse por teléfono, en persona o a través de tu red. No se permiten campañas de email, WhatsApp ni mensajes en frío por redes sociales. EN TU PROPUESTA, CUÉNTANOS 1. Qué experiencia tienes vendiendo a negocios locales. 2. Con qué tipo de negocios de Madrid tienes relación o contacto. 3. Cuántas horas a la semana podrías dedicarle.

opportunities.title: Expert Cabinet Vision Joinery Drafter
opportunities.description: I'm looking for an experienced Cabinet Vision Drafter to assist with ongoing commercial and residential joinery drafting projects. The ideal candidate must have strong experience producing accurate, detailed, manufacturing-ready Cabinet Vision models and professional shop drawings. I will provide project requirements, architectural drawings, construction specifications, drafting standards, and detailed instructions for each assignment. Your responsibility will be to independently complete the assigned drafting work, ensure everything follows the provided standards, and submit the completed deliverables for my review. This is a hands-on technical drafting role, not simply a 2D CAD drawing position. Key Responsibilities - Interpret architectural drawings, specifications, and joinery requirements. - Create accurate 3D joinery models using Cabinet Vision. - Prepare detailed shop drawings, including plans, elevations, sections, and construction details. - Develop manufacturing-ready cabinetry models with correct construction methods. - Follow provided construction standards, material specifications, hardware requirements, and drafting templates. - Work with Cabinet Vision UCS rules, parametric assemblies, and hardware libraries. - Ensure accurate panel dimensions, edge banding, drilling positions, clearances, and joinery connections. - Prepare production information, including cutlists and material schedules where required. - Identify missing information, technical conflicts, or potential manufacturing issues before proceeding. - Make revisions based on feedback and deliver final files within agreed deadlines. - Maintain consistency across multiple joinery units within the same project. Required Skills - Advanced proficiency in Cabinet Vision. - Strong experience in commercial joinery, custom cabinetry, kitchens, wardrobes, vanities, and fit-outs. - Excellent understanding of cabinetry construction and manufacturing processes. - Experience producing detailed, manufacturing-ready shop drawings. - Familiarity with Cabinet Vision UCS, parametric modelling, and customized libraries. - Knowledge of CNC manufacturing requirements and nested-based production. - Ability to interpret architectural drawings and work accurately with metric dimensions. - Strong attention to detail and ability to work independently. - Reliable communication and timely delivery. Preferred Qualifications - Experience working with commercial joinery or cabinet manufacturing companies. - Experience with complex commercial fit-outs and custom joinery. - Ability to understand and adapt quickly to established construction standards. - Experience with AutoCAD. - Familiarity with materials such as melamine, laminate, MDF, timber veneer, and stone. opportunities.title: Gearbox Actuator Design & ANSYS -- 2
opportunities.description: I’m developing a compact gearbox-based actuator and need a mechanical engineer who can carry the concept all the way through detailed verification in ANSYS. Your job starts with refining my preliminary sketches (or proposing your own concept if it proves better), modelling each gear, shaft, housing and bearing, and then setting up all necessary simulations inside ANSYS Workbench. The core objective is to confirm the design’s reliability under realistic loads: bending and torsion on the shafts, contact stresses on the gears, bolt preload in the housing, and overall deformation. Alongside static strength, I also want to see motion behaviour over a full duty cycle so I can verify backlash, efficiency and potential resonance points. If you already have macros or scripts that speed up these studies, all the better. Once the results are in, I’ll need recommendations on material grades, surface treatments and any geometric tweaks that improve durability or reduce weight without driving up machining costs. Organise the findings clearly—screen grabs, contour plots, safety factors—so they can be dropped straight into my project file and shown to the machinist. Deliverables • Parametric 3D CAD files (STEP or native SolidWorks/Inventor) • Complete ANSYS workbench file(s) with solved studies • PDF report summarising loads, boundary conditions, assumptions, results and design changes • Final manufacturing drawings with tolerances, fits and a revision block I will be available daily for quick clarifications and can share load specs, space constraints and photos of the surrounding assembly on request. Let me know your preferred CAD package, ANSYS version and estimated turnaround time so we can lock in milestones right away. I need the freelancer to share their portfolio as a pdf first then only I can choose

opportunities.title: Canal de Youtube: Diseño de Minautura , Edición e Video, Copywriter...
opportunities.description: Estamos buscando un equipo de profesionales freelance altamente talentosos para el lanzamiento y la gestión continua de nuestro primer canal de YouTube. Nuestro objetivo es establecer una presencia sólida y distintiva desde el inicio, con un enfoque en la identidad visual, la producción de contenido de alta calidad y una estrategia de comunicación efectiva. Los roles clave que buscamos cubrir son: 1. Diseñador de Miniaturas para YouTube: Necesitamos un experto en diseño de miniaturas que comprenda la psicología del clic y la importancia de la atracción visual en YouTube. Buscamos a alguien con experiencia demostrable en la creación de miniaturas que generen engagement, o un talento con gran potencial y un ojo excepcional para el diseño, dispuesto a aprender y crecer con nuestro equipo para alcanzar resultados de alto nivel. 2. Editor de Video Creativo: Requerimos un editor de video con amplia experiencia y una gran capacidad creativa. El dominio de Adobe After Effects y otras herramientas de edición es esencial. El contenido principal será en formato podcast sin mostrar el rostro, lo que exige la incorporación de elementos visuales dinámicos. Las responsabilidades incluirán la creación de una apertura inicial impactante para el canal, la integración de gráficos y animaciones durante las conversaciones, la gestión de cambios de slides en momentos estratégicos y el diseño de un cierre efectivo que impulse la interacción, la retención y la participación de la audiencia. 3. Especialista en Contenido y Estrategia: Buscamos un profesional con habilidades destacadas en copywriting y desarrollo de contenido. Esta persona será fundamental para generar textos atractivos, proponer ideas de contenido innovadoras y definir estrategias de comunicación que resuenen con nuestra audiencia. Aunque es nuestro primer canal de YouTube, nuestra marca posee una vasta experiencia en branding, marketing y comunicación visual, por lo que esperamos un enfoque estratégico y de alta calidad. Valoramos el compromiso, la creatividad y la seriedad profesional. Queremos construir un equipo de alto rendimiento que comparta nuestra visión de excelencia y nos ayude a asegurar un lanzamiento exitoso y un crecimiento sostenido del canal. Categoría: Diseño y Multimedia Subcategoría: Imagen Corporativa ¿Cuál es el alcance del proyecto?: Definir desde cero

opportunities.title: Reemplazo realista de integrante en fotos
opportunities.description: Necesito editar 50 fotos de grupo para sustituir siempre a la misma persona por un nuevo integrante. Entrego imágenes del nuevo miembro tanto en solitario como con el mismo grupo, tomadas en la misma sesión, así que el ángulo, la iluminación y el vestuario ya coinciden en la mayoría de los casos. Objetivo • El montaje debe ser invisible: mismos tonos, contraste, texturas y resolución que la foto original. • Rostros y proporciones impecables, sin deformaciones ni rastros de recorte. • Coherencia de color y luz en cada imagen para que nadie note la intervención. Flujo de trabajo sugerido 1. Seleccionar la referencia adecuada del nuevo integrante para cada toma. 2. Integrar con precisión (máscara, ajuste de color, dodge & burn, corrección selectiva). 3. Revisar piel, sombras y reflejos para mantener la naturalidad. 4. Entregar los 50 archivos finales en la resolución original, mismos formatos y nombres de archivo si es posible, listos para impresión y uso digital. Valoro dominio de Photoshop y técnicas de composición avanzada; se aprecian ejemplos previos de retoque de retrato o fotomontaje. Confermo los reemplazos uno a uno para asegurar consistencia antes de cerrar el proyecto. Se paga por la edicion de una foto, si el trabajo esta OK se paga completo por las otras 49
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40815690, publicado hace 1 día). Presupuesto ofrecido: USD 10 - 30.

opportunities.title: Desarrollo de Plataforma Turística Bilingüe con Integración de Apis
opportunities.description: Se busca un desarrollador senior experto para crear una plataforma turística bilingüe (español/inglés) y de fácil administración para Tache Travel. La visión es permitir a los clientes encontrar promociones de navieras, entender tarifas, comparar opciones y reservar o solicitar asesoría personalizada, aprovechando la experiencia y conocimiento de Tache Travel. La plataforma debe integrar y mejorar el uso de sistemas existentes como Odysseus para cruceros y explorar soluciones autorizadas como Expedia o Bedsonline para hoteles, conservando las comisiones. Se requiere una auditoría inicial de la web, permisos de Outside Agents, APIs, proveedores, datos, pagos y comisiones para entregar una arquitectura viable, presupuesto y cronograma. Las funciones principales incluyen: 1. promociones sincronizadas: investigar y conectar con outside agents, odysseus, apis o fuentes oficiales de navieras como norwegian, royal caribbean, carnival, msc, celebrity, princess, holland america, virgin, entre otras. La plataforma deberá mostrar ofertas, vigencia, precios, condiciones y cruceros elegibles, con sincronización autorizada o gestión manual con control de vencimientos. 2. BUSCADOR Y COMPARADOR: Implementar un sistema para filtrar cruceros en promoción por naviera, destino, puerto, fecha, duración, tipo de cabina, precio y beneficios. Deberá detallar lo que incluye cada tarifa (bebidas, restaurantes, Wi-Fi, créditos, impuestos, propinas, cargos y restricciones) y conectar cada oferta con su proceso de reserva. 3. RESERVAS: Optimizar la integración de Odysseus para reservas de cruceros y evaluar la posibilidad de un buscador de hoteles con soluciones autorizadas, asegurando la conservación de comisiones. 4. WEB Y ADMINISTRACIÓN: Desarrollar un diseño premium y responsivo para dispositivos móviles. La plataforma incluirá secciones para cruceros, hoteles, resorts, paquetes, destinos y excursiones. Se necesita un panel de administración intuitivo para actualizar promociones y contenido bilingüe, además de integrar herramientas como HubSpot, WhatsApp, formularios de contacto, optimización SEO y analítica web. Categoría: Programación y Tecnología Subcategoría: Programación Web ¿Cuál es el alcance del proyecto?: Crear un nuevo sitio personalizado

opportunities.title: Trafficker Digital Multimarca Senior
opportunities.description: Trafficker Digital Senior Modalidad: Freelance / Remoto Presupuesto mensual: USD $250 total al mes Gestión: Publicidad digital de 10 marcas Horario de disponibilidad: Lunes a viernes, preferiblemente de 8:00 a.m. a 5:00 p.m. (hora Panamá). Perfil requerido Buscamos un Trafficker Digital Freelancer que hable y escriba español nativo, con mínimo 3 años de experiencia comprobable gestionando campañas publicitarias y optimizando resultados en diferentes plataformas. Debe contar con portafolio de trabajos, casos de éxito y referencias verificables. Experiencia y conocimientos Meta Ads (Facebook e Instagram): campañas de mensajes, leads, agendamiento de citas y conversiones. Google Ads: campañas SEM, búsqueda y Performance Max. LinkedIn Ads y TikTok Ads. Looker Studio: reportes y dashboards de resultados. Experiencia promocionando negocios de salud, belleza, restaurantes, SaaS, aplicaciones web, cursos y eventos. Conocimiento de píxeles, eventos, seguimiento y medición de conversiones. Creatividad y diseño Debe saber desarrollar diferentes ángulos publicitarios, conceptos de anuncios y propuestas creativas según cada público y negocio. Se valorará que tenga conocimientos de diseño y pueda crear o adaptar piezas gráficas cuando sea necesario, utilizando Canva, Photoshop u otras herramientas. Responsabilidades Desarrollar la estrategia publicitaria de cada marca. Coordinar las necesidades de diseño y creatividad. Configurar, ejecutar y administrar campañas. opportunities.description: Necesito apoyo inmediato para localizar y prefiltrar chatters de habla hispana en toda Latinoamérica para una plataforma de contenido para adultos. Requisitos indispensables de cada candidato: • Inglés B2 o superior (oral y escrito). • Laptop con al menos 8 GB de RAM y conexión estable. • Experiencia previa en ventas por chat y manejo de plataformas de contenido para adultos. Alcance del trabajo: 1. Identificar fuentes de talento en la región (grupos, bolsas de empleo, redes sociales, referrals, etc.). 2. Publicar la vacante o contactar perfiles relevantes de forma directa. 3. Realizar un primer filtro de habilidades: nivel de inglés, experiencia en ventas por chat, familiaridad con entornos 18+. 4. Entregarme una lista validada de candidatos listos para entrevista, con CV, datos de contacto y breve resumen de su idoneidad. 5. Me gustaria que las personas que me mandes en la lista ya esten en conocimiento de los detalles del trabajo y esten listos para una entrevista conmigo Valoro que me propongas tu metodología y un estimado del número de candidatos que podrías presentar en el plazo que sugieras. Idealmente, quiero comenzar las entrevistas cuanto antes, así que priorizaré a quien demuestre un proceso ágil y ya tenga acceso a bases activas de talento.

opportunities.title: Plataforma IA para Protección Reputacional
opportunities.description: # Desarrollo de BOT y sistema automatizado contra campañas de difamación y ataques reputacionales ### Descripción del proyecto Buscamos un experto en desarrollo de bots, inteligencia artificial, automatización y ciberseguridad para desarrollar una herramienta tecnológica enfocada en la protección de la reputación digital de personas, marcas y empresas. El objetivo es crear un sistema capaz de identificar, monitorear y responder ante campañas maliciosas de difamación, publicaciones falsas, spam, suplantación de identidad, ataques coordinados y contenido perjudicial difundido en redes sociales y plataformas digitales. ### Funcionalidades requeridas **1. Monitoreo inteligente** - Identificación automática de publicaciones difamatorias. - Seguimiento de perfiles que generan contenido malicioso. - Detección de campañas coordinadas. - Alertas en tiempo real cuando se detecten nuevos ataques. - Registro de enlaces, perfiles, publicaciones y evidencias. **2. Sistema automatizado de reportes** - Automatización de denuncias legítimas ante plataformas. - Identificación de publicaciones que incumplan las políticas de cada red social. - Gestión y seguimiento del estado de las denuncias. - Organización de evidencias para facilitar solicitudes de eliminación de contenido. **3. Protección de perfiles y empresas** - Detección de perfiles falsos y suplantaciones. - Monitoreo de comentarios maliciosos y spam. - Identificación de redes de cuentas utilizadas para atacar una marca. - Herramientas para proteger cuentas y canales digitales. **4. Gestión de reputación y respuesta** - Sistema de respuesta ante campañas de desinformación. - Generación de respuestas y comunicados mediante IA. - Herramientas para contrarrestar información falsa con evidencias verificables. - Panel centralizado para administrar diferentes marcas, empresas y perfiles. **5. Panel de administración** - Dashboard para gestionar múltiples empresas y perfiles. - Seguimiento de incidentes. - Estadísticas de publicaciones detectadas y reportadas. - Historial de acciones y resultados. ### Perfil del profesional que buscamos - Experiencia desarrollando bots y sistemas de automatización. - Conocimiento de APIs de Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, X y otras plataformas. - Experiencia en inteligencia artificial y procesamiento de lenguaje natural. - Conocimientos de ciberseguridad y protección de reputación digital. - Capacidad para desarrollar soluciones escalables. ### Objetivo final Desarrollar una herramienta profesional que permita actuar de manera rápida, organizada y automatizada frente a campañas de difamación maliciosa, protegiendo la imagen, credibilidad y reputación de personas y empresas. Buscamos un desarrollador que pueda proponer soluciones innovadoras, presentar una arquitectura técnica y ejecutar el proyecto por fases.

📲 Contacto directo en San Agustín, Huila (Colombia): **+57 322 273 9034**.
